title: HR Partner, AWS
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a dynamic, growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided companies of all sizes with an infrastructure platform in the cloud. Using AWS, companies can requisition compute power, storage, and other services – gaining access to a global computing infrastructure that is the backbone of Amazon.com’s multi-billion-dollar retail business. Today, AWS provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers millions of active monthly customers from start-ups to multi-national corporations to governments.  
  
At Amazon, we are committed to being Earth’s Best Employer and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic leaders passionate about making every day better for all employees (Builders) – and you would play a key role in that journey! Our HR Partners care deeply about the employee experience and support builders and managers to focus on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.  
  
The HR Partner role in our Builder Experience Team (BeXT) focuses on the Builder experience. You will be working with business teams and other cross-functional HR teams in driving and deploying strategies. Great opportunity for a highly motivated, self-directed individual to gain valuable HR experience in a fast-paced, dynamic, globally scaling organization - and have fun doing it as an Amazonian!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Consult, coach, develop, and support leadership through decision making with empathy and sound judgement; collaborating and actioning on talent management processes, people development and performance management, compensation, and Employee Relations issues.
* Foster and role model an environment of inclusion for all Builders.
* Advocate for Builders’ needs through end-to-end experiences that help Builders feel fully engaged in the work they do and valued for who they are.
* Equitably exercise high-judgement, manage through ambiguity and serve as first point of escalation for Builder concerns.
* Support Builder queries and situations with discretion and expertise navigating Amazon Policies and applying high judgement as necessary.
* Actively promote adoption of technology and self-service.
* Collaborate and influence multiple levels of the organization ranging from Builders to senior leaders.
* Conduct difficult workplace investigations in collaboration with Builder Relations.
* Coach HR new hires, mentor HR professionals, engaged in global projects and contribute to regional programs.

  
A day in the life  

* Application of HR fundamentals.
* Problem solving and influencing in diverse populations.
* Working in a rapid and complex changing environment driven by continuous innovation.
* Influence change and foster an environment of inclusion for our Builders.
* Partnering with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward looking strategies and goals focused on the Builder experience.

  
About the team  
BeXT delivers personalized people-support to AWS Builders to amplify the voice of the Builder. In this role, you will collaborate with AWS business leaders and line HR teams to innovate, implement, and deploy HR strategies from customer service, talent and performance management, compensation, employee relations and other HR functions. In addition, you will provide support to our Builders and their leaders aligned to AWS flywheel(s) or region(s) calling on HR expertise and empathy.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 7+ years of HR Generalist, HR Business Partner or HR manager experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience consulting with senior leadership and executives in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in employee relations, labor relations, or labor/employment law
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
* Experience working with and protecting confidential and sensitive HR information
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working with teams across APAC region
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and ability to translate data into actionable insights
* Intellectual curiosity; brings insight and fresh thinking to the team and business
* Demonstrated empathy in navigating complex people situations

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Oracle EPM Specialist - IT Architect
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as an IT Architect III and be part of our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this role, you'll design and implement effective cloud solutions, focusing on EPM architecture and automation. You'll contribute to technology advancement, transforming on-premise applications into cloud-centric solutions while ensuring reliability and disaster recovery. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, propose innovative approaches, and advance cloud technology. You'll support and guide application owners while maintaining expertise in emerging technologies and industry best practices. Your work will directly impact operations through the implementation of sophisticated machine learning solutions, cloud infrastructure optimization, and the development of scalable IT architectures.  
  
We are seeking an Oracle EPM Consultant with strong expertise in Enterprise Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (EPBCS) to support, develop, and optimize enterprise planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting solutions.

The consultant will serve as the primary functional and technical resource for EPBCS, ensuring application stability, data accuracy, security, and performance during planning and financial close cycles. This role involves translating business requirements into scalable solutions, managing integrations, troubleshooting issues, and delivering application enhancements.

Working closely with Finance, IT, implementation partners, and Financial Systems leadership, the consultant will take ownership of knowledge transfer and support the execution of the EPM roadmap. Exposure to PCMCS and EDMCS is desirable, with these applications representing a secondary area of responsibility.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**EPBCS Solution Design & Development**

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional designs, technical specifications, and EPBCS solutions.
* Configure and maintain planning applications, dimensions, hierarchies, forms, dashboards, navigation flows, task lists, and approval workflows.
* Develop and optimize business rules, calculation scripts, member formulas, and allocation logic using Calculation Manager and, where applicable, Groovy.
* Support planning models across scenarios, versions, entities, currencies, and business units.
* Enhance budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and management reporting processes.
* Configure and support relevant EPBCS frameworks, such as Financials, Workforce based on business requirements.

**Data Integration & Management**

* Configure, administer, and monitor Data Integration/Data Exchange processes, data mappings, pipelines, and import/export definitions.
* Manage actuals, budget, forecast, and metadata integrations between EPBCS and source systems.
* Validate and reconcile financial data to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system owners to assess dependencies and resolve integration issues.
* Automate routine data loads, metadata updates, and application processes using EPM Automate, REST APIs, or scripting.

**Application Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide functional and technical support during budgeting, forecasting, financial close, and reporting cycles.
* Investigate and resolve data load failures, mapping errors, calculation issues, validation failures, and performance problems.
* Support users with forms, dashboards, approvals, reporting, and Smart View queries.
* Perform root cause analysis, implement preventive fixes, and manage Oracle Service Requests through resolution.
* Monitor scheduled jobs, business rules, integrations, and application performance.

**Security, Maintenance & Release Management**

* Administer user access, predefined roles, application permissions, and dimension-level security.
* Review monthly Oracle EPM release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate regression testing.
* Manage controlled migration of application changes across development, test, and production environments.
* Maintain application backups, configuration documentation, support runbooks, and operating procedures.
* Follow change management processes and support audit and internal control requirements.

**Business Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Finance and IT teams to improve planning processes, application usability, and operational efficiency.
* Assess the downstream impact of application and integration changes.
* Lead knowledge transfer from implementation partners and establish sustainable application support practices.
* Work with Financial Systems leadership to prioritize enhancements and deliver EPM roadmap initiatives.

**Secondary Support – PCMCS & EDMCS**

* Provide limited support for PCMCS allocation models and profitability processes, as required.
* Assist with EDMCS metadata updates, hierarchy maintenance, and subscriptions.
* Coordinate with application specialists for complex PCMCS and EDMCS requirements.

### **Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience implementing, developing, or supporting Oracle EPBCS/EPM Planning applications.
* Understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and financial close dependencies.
* Experience with dimensions, forms, dashboards, approval workflows, business rules, calculation scripts, and Smart View.
* Strong knowledge of Essbase concepts, multidimensional modeling, and calculation performance optimization.
* Experience with Data Integration/Data Exchange, data mappings, metadata management, and financial data reconciliation.
* Experience managing application security, migrations, monthly update testing, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to translate Finance requirements into practical, maintainable technical solutions.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Groovy, EPM Automate, REST APIs, and scripting.
* Experience with EPBCS Financials, Workforce.
* Exposure to Oracle ERP or other financial source-system integrations.
* Familiarity with PCMCS and EDMCS.

title: Senior SOC Verification Engineer
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (*SCHIE*) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.

The Compute Silicon & Manufacturing Engineering (CSME) organization within SCHIE is responsible for design, development, manufacturing and packaging of Microsoft's state-of-the-art computer chips, notably the Azure Cobalt. Our solutions provide sustainable strategic advantages to Microsoft and enable our customers to achieve more.

As Microsoft's cloud business continues to grow the ability to deploy new offerings and hardware infrastructure on time, in high volume with high quality and lowest cost is of paramount importance. To achieve this goal, the **Verification & Validation** team is instrumental in defining and delivering operational measures of success for hardware manufacturing, improving the planning process, quality, delivery, scale and sustainability related to Microsoft cloud hardware. We are looking for experienced engineers with a dedicated passion for customer focused solutions, insight and industry knowledge to envision and implement future technical solutions that will manage and optimize the Cloud infrastructure.

We are looking for a **Sr SOC Verification Engineer** to join the team to support our mission and culture. This key role will impact the organization by **driving SoC verification strategy and execution for complex IP/SOC designs.**

#SCHIE #CSME

  
  
**Responsibilities**

The candidate for this position will be expected and able to complete the following responsibilities:

* Establish yourself as an integral member of a pre-silicon SoC verification team, owning aspects of SoC verification, and aligning with architecture, design, firmware, and emulation.
* Become knowledgeable on the overall SoC architecture.
* Develop verification strategy, test plans, requirements, environments, tools, and methodologies.
* Apply your knowledge of SoC verification principles and techniques and your judgement to write test plans and implement them by developing tests, test generators, test benches, checkers, coverage, and other verification collateral.
* Run tests, correlate results with architecture, debug failures to root cause, and recommend fixes.
* Apply your growth mindset to learn and adapt in a complex and dynamic environment.
* Engage with partners to drive continuous improvement to the architecture, design, and verification of plans/collateral, and methodology to prevent, reduce, and/or find bugs sooner, more easily, or more reliably.
* Mentor and coach team members
* Apply your One Microsoft mentality to collaborate with and influence architects, logic designers, post-silicon validators, other verification engineers, and IP and tool providers.
* Embody our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of pre-silicon SOC or subsystem or IP verification experience.
* Candidate should have at least a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related degree
6+ years of verification experience working on SOC designs, with 2+ years PCIe/CXL/Data accelerator verification experience  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience as part of a SoC and/or IP development team focusing on Data accelerators (DMA, compression, decompression, encryption and decryption engine)
* Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following:
  + SoC verification
  + ARM architecture
  + Data accelerators (DMA, compression, decompression, encryption and decryption engine)
  + Memory Controller/PHY IPs, DDR protocols
  + Coherent and non-coherent fabric IPs and protocols
  + PCIe Controller/PHY IPs and protocols
  + ACE lite or CHI bus protocols
* Working knowledge of C/C++
* Experience with emulation, constraints, and implications on SoC verification
* Proficient communication, collaboration and teamwork skills and ability to contribute to diverse and inclusive teams.

**Screening Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their US. residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Manager of Software Engineering
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Consumer and Community Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

We are seeking an experienced Java Distributed Systems Engineer to design, build, and operate highly scalable, resilient, and cloud-native backend systems. The role involves working on modern databases, Spring Boot–based microservices, and cloud infrastructure, with a strong emphasis on non-functional aspects.

**Job responsibilities**

* Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Develops secure high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
* Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems
* Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture
* Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Leads communities of practice across Software Engineering to drive awareness and use of new and leading-edge technologies
* Adds to team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Advanced in Java programming language
* Proficiency in automation and continuous delivery methods
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Experience designing, deploying, and managing containerized applications using Kubernetes
* In-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their IT systems
* Practical AWS experience

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Co-Pilot skills
* AWS solution architect certification
* Familiarity with Springboot

**ABOUT US**

title: Mainframe Storage Support, System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

The Mainframe Storage Support Specialist will provide expert-level support for enterprise mainframe storage environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance of mission-critical services. The role involves administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and implementation of storage solutions across complex z/OS environments.

  

**What you will do**

* Provide day-to-day support for IBM mainframe storage infrastructure and associated technologies.
* Manage and maintain DASD storage subsystems, storage allocation, and performance optimization.
* Support IBM DFSMS components, including SMS, ACS routines, HSM, DFP, DSS, and RMM.
* Administer and support storage hardware and software platforms such as IBM DS8K, FlashSystem, and related storage technologies.
* Perform incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution for storage-related issues.
* Participate in change management activities, including implementation planning, risk assessment, testing, and execution.
* Monitor storage utilization, analyze trends, and perform capacity management activities to ensure future growth requirements are met.
Support  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience supporting IBM Mainframe Storage environments, with strong knowledge of IBM z/OS operating systems and storage architecture.
* Hands-on experience with the DFSMS suite (SMS, DFHSM/HSM, DFDSS, ICKDSF, RMM, IDCAMS, ISMF).
* Hands-on experience supporting IBM DS8000 storage platforms.
Practical experience managing backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery processes.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Deep understanding of DASD management, storage provisioning, performance tuning, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with storage monitoring/reporting tools and incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to support critical systems under tight operational and SLA requirements.
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering (or equivalent experience) and strong English communication skills.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AI Operations Engineer
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 7 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 2 years of related experience.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Experience working in Kubernetes, Docker
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Managing Consultant Corporate Strategy & Development
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
Corporate Strategy professionals shape Kyndryl's long-term direction and growth by leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives and supporting executive decision-making. They partner closely with senior leaders to develop and execute enterprise strategies, leverage market, financial, customer, and competitive insights, and solve complex business challenges that drive growth and enterprise value.

Combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, financial expertise, business case development, and executive communication skills, they support strategic planning, growth initiatives, investment decisions, and enterprise transformation programs that strengthen competitive advantage and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for shaping the future of a global technology company? Are you energized by the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders on high-impact initiatives that influence growth, investment decisions, and long-term enterprise strategy? Then we have a unique opportunity for you as a Managing Consultant, Corporate Strategy.

In this role, you will lead and support some of Kyndryl's most important strategic priorities, helping define the choices that shape the company's future direction and growth. Working closely with senior executives, business-unit leaders, finance teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will evaluate complex business challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and develop recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* As a Managing Consultant, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the enterprise.
* You will partner with leadership teams to develop corporate and business-unit strategies, assess growth opportunities, evaluate investment priorities, and support critical executive decisions.
* You will conduct rigorous market research, competitive benchmarking, strategic assessments, and financial analyses to identify emerging opportunities, address key business challenges, and help position Kyndryl for long-term success in a dynamic and rapidly evolving marketplace.
* You will play a central role in strategic planning, business case development, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Leveraging your analytical rigor, structured problem-solving capabilities, and financial expertise, you will develop executive-level recommendations, strategic roadmaps, investment theses, and implementation plans that enable leadership teams to make informed, fact-based decisions.
* You will also help ensure alignment across stakeholders, monitor progress against strategic objectives, and support the successful execution of critical initiatives.
* Our consultants are restless for innovation.
    
  They thrive at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and transformation, helping shape the future of Kyndryl and our customers.
    
  So, if you are a problem-solver, an analytical thinker, and a self-starter who enjoys working on high-visibility assignments with senior leadership, we want to hear from you. Apply today to join our dynamic team and help solve the strategic challenges that will define Kyndryl's next chapter.

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

**Who You Are**

You are an experienced corporate strategy, business consulting professional - you are good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. And finally, you are open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD) in business, economics, finance, engineering, analytics, or a related field
* Over 7 years of experience in corporate strategy, pricing strategy, go-to-market strategy, commercial strategy, or management consulting, with 4+ years preferably with leading management consulting firms or technology services / software companies
* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings
* Ability to build robust business cases, price waterfalls, margin analyses, elasticity assessments, unit economics models, total cost of ownership models, and customer ROI frameworks
* Experience shaping go-to-market strategies, including sales and channel motions, portfolio positioning, launch planning, customer segmentation, partner monetization, and KPI frameworks
* Skilled in gathering and synthesizing data, conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, customer research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations

* Ability to lead independent workstreams within larger corporate strategy initiatives and influence stakeholders across Offering, Sales, Finance, Delivery, Legal, and executive leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for developing executive and board-level presentations, pricing recommendations, decision memos, and implementation roadmaps
Extensive customer-facing or stakeholder-facing exposure with strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with enterprise procurement dynamics, deal economics, and technology services / software sales cycles  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in global technology services, managed infrastructure, cloud, software / SaaS, cybersecurity, IT modernization, or hyperscale partner ecosystems
* Experience supporting pricing transformations, portfolio simplification, commercial governance, go-to-market redesign, sales enablement, or partner monetization programs
* Familiarity with pricing analytics, CRM / CPQ workflows, cloud financial management / FinOps, product management practices, or software licensing operations
Industry certifications or training in cloud platforms, FinOps, pricing, product management, strategic finance, or related disciplines  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: AI Operations Engineer - 8 to 12 yrs
description:
Meet the Team 
  
The Cisco AI Software& Platform Group incubates and delivers Generative AI based solutions to reinvent Cisco's existing Products and how customers interact with them. Our Group is also introducing new offerings that help customers roll out Generative AI at scale while doing so responsibly. Ultimately, we are doing so through internal platforms that unlock the benefits of this technology for Cisco teams and partners across our Security, Enterprise Networking, Collaboration and Splunk portfolios.
  
  
Your Impact 
  
Cisco is looking for a highly experienced and innovative DevOps Engineer to join
  
our global DevOps team. In this critical role, you will architect and build scalable, secure
  
cloud infrastructure and lead the adoption of best-in-class DevOps practices across the
  
organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless code
  
delivery, system reliability, and operational excellence for our SaaS platforms.
  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement end-to-end CI/CD workflows in a large-scale, distributed environment—enabling both on-demand and scheduled builds and deployments with zero downtime.
* Scale microservice-based platforms across multiple geographic regions, with a focus on container orchestration (Kubernetes), cost optimization, and automated scaling solutions.
* Lead cross-functional DevOps projects from inception to completion defining success criteria, coordinating execution, and measuring outcomes against clear KPIs.
* Collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams to streamline delivery pipelines and promote DevOps best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
* Advocate automation in every layer of the infrastructure stack using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform, Helm, and GitOps frameworks.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging DevOps tools and technologies to increase system resilience, reduce operational overhead, and enhance developer productivity.
* Integrate AI-assisted tooling, copilots, and AIOps into day-to-day DevOps, CI/CD workflows, infrastructure automation, testing, and incident response to enhance efficiency and system reliability.
* Participate in on-call rotation.
* Serve as a subject matter expert within the DevOps organization—promoting a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Comp Science, Engineering (or related field /industry) + 7 years of DevOps experience, Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 2 years of related experience.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
* Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Docker
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Go).
* Hands-on experience using AI developer tools (e.g., AI coding assistants).

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Deep expertise in CI/CD tooling and practices, including hands-on experience with systems like Jenkins, Github, ArgoCD, or similar.
* Demonstrated success scaling containerized microservices across regions with cost and performance optimizations.
* Proven leadership in cross-functional engineering projects with measurable outcomes.
* Experience building applications or services.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Digital Sol/Serv Line Sr Manager
description:
**Title:** Technical Solutions Architect
  
  
**Practice:** AI Contact Center Transformation
  
**Focus:** Technical Architecture, Platform Engineering, Integration Design (Presales Early Delivery)
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
The Technical Solutions Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing, validating, and architecting AI-powered contact center solutions that are scalable, secure, and operationally sound. You translate business requirements into detailed technical blueprints, working closely with presales teams, Solution Consultants, and client IT/engineering stakeholders to ensure solutions are feasible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Your primary focus is on the technical design and integration strategy—ensuring that AI agents, CCaaS platforms, CRM systems, and enterprise data layers work together seamlessly. You will lead technical discovery, design solution architectures, validate integrations, and provide the engineering guardrails that enable successful delivery by POD teams.
  
  
You ensure that what we sell can actually be built—and built well.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Technical Discovery Infrastructure Assessment
  

* Lead technical discovery sessions with client IT, telephony, and infrastructure teams to assess current environment and readiness.
* Evaluate existing CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio, etc.) for AI agent integration capabilities.
* Assess CRM such as ServiceNow/MS Dynamics/Salesforce, knowledge base, and backend system APIs for data accessibility, and integration feasibility.
* Analyze telephony infrastructure (SIP trunking, IVR legacy systems, call routing) and identify migration or integration requirements.
* Identify technical risks, constraints, and dependencies (network latency, API rate limits, data compliance, PII/PCI requirements).

2. AI Agent CCaaS Platform Architecture Design
  

* Design end-to-end technical architectures for AI agent deployments, including conversational AI platforms, LLM orchestration, knowledge retrieval (RAG), and real-time integrations.
* Define integration patterns between AI agent platforms and CCaaS environments.
* Architect omnichannel solutions spanning voice, chat, SMS, and digital channels with consistent agent behavior and context management.
* Design call flow logic, escalation routing, fallback strategies, and human-in-the-loop handoff mechanisms.
* Define data flow diagrams, API contracts, authentication/authorization schemes (OAuth, API keys, SSO), and middleware requirements.

3. Integration Data Architecture
  

* Design integration architecture for connecting AI agents to backend systems: CRMs, ERPs, billing systems, knowledge bases, and ticketing platforms.
* Define data schemas, payload structures, and real-time vs. batch integration strategies.
* Architect secure data handling for PII, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR-compliant environments, including data masking, encryption, and audit logging.

4. Platform Selection Technical Validation
  

* Conduct technical proof-of-concepts (POCs) and feasibility studies to validate platform capabilities, integration complexity, and performance benchmarks.
* Assess CCaaS native AI capabilities vs. third-party AI agent platforms to determine optimal architecture.
* Define build vs. buy strategies for conversational components, analytics, and quality management tools.

5. Presales Technical Enablement RFP Response
  

* Partner with Solution Consultants during presales to provide technical depth, validate feasibility, and design proposed architectures.
* Lead technical portions of client presentations, solution demos, and architecture review sessions.
* Author technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs, including architecture diagrams, integration specifications, and infrastructure requirements.
* Articulate technical differentiators, platform advantages, and engineering best practices to client technical stakeholders.
* Defend solution designs against client technical objections and provide alternative approaches when needed.

6. SOW Scoping Engineering Handoff
  

* Define detailed technical scope for Statements of Work (SOWs), including integration points, data requirements, infrastructure dependencies, and deliverables.
* Specify technical assumptions, constraints, and exclusions to protect delivery feasibility and margins.
* Create engineering handoff documentation: architecture diagrams, integration specs, API documentation, and technical requirements.
* Conduct transition sessions with Delivery PODs to ensure technical intent, design rationale, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly understood.
* Participate in design reviews and critical milestones (e.g., technical design approval, integration validation, UAT) to ensure delivery aligns with architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Presales, or Platform Engineering, with a focus on contact center or enterprise communication platforms.
* Deep CCaaS Expertise: Hands-on experience with at least two major CCaaS platforms (Genesys Cloud/Engage, Five9, NICE CXone, Amazon Connect, Twilio Flex, Cisco Webex Contact Center).
* AI Agent Conversational AI Knowledge: Familiarity with AI agent platforms, LLM orchestration, NLU/NLP, intent recognition, dialogue management, and knowledge retrieval (RAG).
* Integration Architecture: Proven experience designing RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware , and real-time data integration patterns.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and defend architectural decisions with technical teams.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; understanding of compute, networking, security, and serverless architectures.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Experience with AI agent platforms
* Hands-on experience with telephony protocols
* Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, utilities) with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or GDPR compliance requirements.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect) or CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Five9, NICE).

KEY SUCCESS METRICS
  

* Quality and feasibility of technical architectures and integration designs.
* Client technical stakeholder confidence in proposed solution and delivery approach.
* Accuracy of technical scoping in SOWs (minimal scope creep or technical surprises during delivery).
* Successful engineering handoffs with clear, actionable technical documentation.
* Delivery POD velocity and technical alignment with original architecture vision.
* Contribution to won deals through technical credibility and solution differentiation.

title: Conversational AI Architect - Google Cloud Gemini CX
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking a **Conversational AI Architect** to design, build and scale enterprise-grade conversational and agentic AI solutions on Google Cloud. This role combines deep technical expertise in Gemini CX, Dialogflow CX and Vertex AI with hands-on engineering leadership to move generative AI agents from pilot to secure, high-volume production environments.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and deploy enterprise-grade agentic AI and conversational AI solutions using Gemini CX, Vertex AI Agent Studio, Dialogflow CX and supporting Google Cloud AI services
* Orchestrate hybrid conversational workflows by combining generative playbooks and autonomous agent behaviors with deterministic Dialogflow CX state-machine controls
* Build and optimize RAG pipelines using Vertex AI Search to securely ground agents in enterprise documents, knowledge repositories and business data
* Develop secure backend integrations, connectors and webhooks using Cloud Run, Cloud Functions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate CRM, ERP and internal enterprise systems
* Implement security and compliance guardrails using Model Armor, VPC Service Controls, IAM least-privilege policies and appropriate data isolation controls
* Build conversation telemetry and analytics pipelines using BigQuery and CCAI Insights for error-taxonomy analysis, intent health, containment reporting and operational improvement
* Provide hands-on engineering leadership, write production-grade code, troubleshoot complex platform issues and guide solutions through production deployment and scale

**Requirements**

* 12-20 years of overall experience in IT
* Expertise in Gemini CX, Google Cloud Contact Center AI (CCAI), Vertex AI Agent Studio and the Advanced Agent Modeling (AAM) framework
* Proven experience designing and deploying agentic and conversational AI systems, including goal-oriented agents, multi-agent workflows and enterprise-scale customer interaction solutions
* Expertise in Dialogflow CX, including pages, parameters, conditional routing, transition routes, Speech-to-Text tuning, Text-to-Speech and telephony/SIP configurations
* Experience building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Vertex AI Search and grounding AI agents securely with enterprise knowledge sources
* Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with hands-on development of APIs, webhooks, connectors and backend integrations using Cloud Run and Cloud Functions
* Knowledge of GCP infrastructure, BigQuery, Looker Studio, Terraform, IAM, VPC Service Controls, Model Armor, cloud security, data anonymization and enterprise security controls
* Proven experience moving generative AI agents from pilot/MVP stages into secure, scalable and high-volume production environments

**Nice to have**

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer certification
* Completion of Google Cloud Agentic AI or Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (GECX) learning paths, and experience with automation libraries such as dfcx-scrapi
* Experience delivering high-volume customer service solutions in Financial Services, Telecom, Retail or Healthcare environments

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

Requisition #: 343990

  

**Life at Lumen**

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

To learn more about Life at Lumen and how we live the Lumen 8, please visit:
  
https://jobs.lumen.com/global/en/life-at-lumen

  

**Background Screening**

If you are selected for a position, there will be a background screen, which may include checks for criminal records and/or motor vehicle reports and/or drug screening, depending on the position requirements. For more information on these checks, please refer to the Post Offer section of our FAQ page . Job-related concerns identified during the background screening may disqualify you from the new position or your current role. Background results will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

  

**Equal Employment Opportunities**

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all persons regardless of race, color, ancestry, citizenship, national origin, religion, veteran status, disability, genetic characteristic or information, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, family status, pregnancy, or other legally protected status (collectively, “protected statuses”). We do not tolerate unlawful discrimination in any employment decisions, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, promotion, benefits, discipline, termination, job assignments or training.

  

**Privacy Notice**

title: Data Architect Sr. Advisor
description:
**Role:** Fabric Architect
  
  
**Total Experience:** 12+ years
  
**Relevant Experience:** 8+ years
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Lead Fabric Architect will own the end-to-end technical architecture and design assurance for the Microsoft Fabric platform. The role will define high-level and low-level designs, establish platform guardrails, guide capacity and workspace design, and ensure the solution is secure, scalable, supportable and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the solution architecture, including High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), architecture decisions and technical design documentation.
* Define Microsoft Fabric platform architecture, workspace topology, capacity planning, environment strategy and workload allocation.
* Establish architectural guardrails covering security, identity, networking, governance, naming conventions and resource management.
* Define architecture patterns for Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, shortcuts, data ingestion, transformation and consumption, as applicable to the solution.
* Guide the implementation of development, test, UAT and production environments and their promotion strategy.
* Provide technical authority across platform engineering, data engineering, DevOps, analytics and AI workstreams.
* Review and assure designs for scalability, performance, resilience, maintainability, security and cost optimisation.
* Define integration patterns with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Platform and other required enterprise services.
* Guide monitoring, observability, operational support, disaster recovery and business continuity design, as applicable.
* Support technical risk management, design reviews, proof of concepts and resolution of complex architectural issues.

Required Skills and Experience
  

* 15+ years of overall IT experience, including 10+ years in solution architecture, data platform architecture or cloud engineering.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric architecture and its core capabilities.
* Experience designing enterprise data platforms using Lakehouse, Warehouse, OneLake, Direct Lake, semantic models and related Fabric services.
* Strong understanding of Fabric capacity management, workspace architecture, security, access control and environment management.
* Experience defining HLDs, LLDs, architecture standards, design patterns and technical governance.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure security, networking, integration and enterprise identity patterns.
* Knowledge of data governance, data lifecycle management, monitoring, performance optimisation and cost management.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge design decisions and guide engineering teams.

**Preferred:** Experience in banking or regulated environments, with familiarity with enterprise security, auditability, data protection and technology risk requirements.

title: Application Lead Test Engineer

* Experience with Firebase, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, enterprise CRM/ERP platforms, and mobile analytics.

* Familiarity with ITIL, incident management, problem management, and change and release management.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, commercially minded, technically proficient, and comfortable leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners. Key Responsibilities

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.
