title: Director of Platform Engineering
description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Role purpose**
----------------

The Director of Platform Engineering is the single accountable owner for the platform and data engineering capabilities used across every product domain in the business. The role consolidates Platform Engineering and Data Platform under one senior leader, and runs those capabilities as internal products with named service expectations, a published roadmap, and a regular review cadence with Domain Directors. This is a new role, created to separate architectural authority from operational delivery. The Chief Architect sets technical direction; this role owns the delivery, reliability, and adoption of the shared capabilities that direction depends on. The two roles are peers.

**Reporting and scope**
-----------------------

* **Direct reports:** Platform Engineering Manager, Data Platform Lead. Indirect organisation of approximately 15 engineers at steady state.
* **Internal customers:** Three product domains (360, Assure and Learn) plus internal engineering and operations teams.
* **Peer relationships:** Chief Architect, Domain Directors, Product Directors, Head of Business Technology

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Run shared capabilities as products.** Define service expectations, roadmaps, and adoption metrics for Platform Engineering and Data Platform. Be the single named owner for operational performance: incident response, SLOs, capacity, cost-to-serve, and roadmap delivery.

**Earn the trust of Domain Directors.** Treat domain teams as customers. Establish a regular review cadence with each Domain Director. Where a shared capability is not fit for a domain's needs, lead the work to fix it rather than defending the status quo.

**Partner with the Chief Architect.** Translate architectural direction (multi-tenancy, AI paved roads, Technology Radar) into deliverable platform capabilities on a documented timeline. Surface implementation realities that should inform the architectural roadmap.

**Manage cloud cost.** Own the FinOps practice for the platform estate. Drive unit cost down without compromising reliability and give domain teams the visibility they need to manage their own consumption.

**Build the team.** Coach, develop, and where needed recruit the sub-function leads. Build a team that can operate the function without the Director being the bottleneck for every decision.

**What success looks like at twelve months**
--------------------------------------------

* Platform Engineering and Data Platform operate under published service expectations, with a regular review cadence with each Domain Director.
* Incident response, SLO attainment, and cloud unit cost are tracked, reported, and trending in the right direction.
* Platform compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and IRAP is generated as a by-product of normal operations rather than as a separate audit project.
* The two sub-function leads are operating as a coherent leadership team with clear ownership of their domains.

**Essential experience**
------------------------

* Five or more years of engineering leadership, with at least three years owning a platform, infrastructure, or shared services function at director level or above.
* Demonstrated experience running engineering capabilities as internal products, including setting service expectations, managing roadmaps, and being accountable for adoption.
* Track record in a multi-product SaaS environment, with credible experience of the trade-offs between centralised platform investment and domain team autonomy.
* Direct accountability for AWS cloud infrastructure at scale, including FinOps practices and unit cost management.
* Experience as the engineering owner for at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent regulated compliance regime.
* Track record of building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at managerial level.

**Desirable experience**
------------------------

* Exposure to data platform engineering, including the operational realities of running analytics and data pipelines as a shared capability.
* Experience in EHS, GRC, or another regulated B2B SaaS domain.
* Experience leading a transition from federated to centralised shared services, including the change management involved.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Comfortable with productive friction.** Architecture and delivery are inherently in tension. You see that tension as where the work gets done, not as a problem to be eliminated.
* **Customer mindset toward internal teams.** You earn adoption by being genuinely useful, not by mandate. You would rather change a shared capability than win an argument about it.
* **Operationally credible.** You can be in the detail of an incident or a roadmap commitment when the situation requires it, without making yourself the bottleneck for normal operations.
* **Direct.** You give and receive feedback clearly, and you are willing to disagree with peers in the room rather than after the meeting.

**Why join Evotix?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
* **Time to Recharge:** Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing. (AMER/EMEA)
* **Financial Future:** Generous tiered 401k plan that increases over time. (AMER)
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**  
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  
  
*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

title: Public Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a **Public Cloud Solutions Architect** at Kyndryl, you act as the trusted advisor who turns business goals into cloud architecture that actually ships. You work closely with client executives, enterprise architects, security and compliance teams, governance, delivery, and our hyperscaler partners to keep everyone aligned on one technical direction. You get involved early, helping shape the strategy and the migration and modernization roadmap, and you stay through delivery so the architecture goes live on time, on budget, and secure by design.

  
  

**What you will do**  
This is a senior, client-facing role. **To the client, you are the go-to expert on public cloud.** You run discovery and assessment workshops, build the business case and total cost of ownership, and translate requirements into well-architected solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Increasingly, that means designing for AI and agentic AI as well, from the data and platform foundations through to the workloads themselves.

  

You will decide what Kyndryl will deliver, design the landing zones, networking, identity, data, and application patterns behind it, and lead the implementation teams to a clean result.
  
  
The role goes beyond any single engagement. You will mentor other architects and consultants, build reference architectures and reusable accelerators, and help set our delivery standards and governance. You will also help set Kyndryl apart through newer capabilities such as agentic AI, automation, and modernization accelerators that improve delivery quality, speed, and the value clients see. Kyndryl works across all the major public cloud platforms, so you will use what you know, keep building on it, and know when to bring in specialist SMEs.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**  
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

* 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise IT solutions, including at least 4+ years focused on public cloud architecture
* Deep, hands-on solutions architecture experience on at least one major hyperscaler (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) and working knowledge of a second; multi-cloud experience strongly preferred
* A track record leading cloud migration and modernization programs, covering assessment and discovery, the 7 Rs (rehost, replatform, refactor, and so on), landing zone and well-architected design, and large-scale workload migration
* Strong command of core cloud domains: compute, storage, networking (VPC/VNet, hybrid connectivity, DNS, load balancing), identity and access management, and cloud security and governance
* Solid grasp of cloud-native and modernization patterns: containers and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), microservices, serverless, and application refactoring
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI and agentic AI solutions on cloud, including the underlying data and platform foundations, the AI/ML services across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and how generative and agentic workloads change architecture, security, and cost
* Experience applying AI to the delivery itself, using AI-led approaches, automation, and agentic tooling to speed up assessment, migration, modernization, and quality assurance
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible) and with CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Practical understanding of security by design, cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and well-architected or cloud adoption frameworks
* Proven consulting skills: running client workshops, building business cases and TCO/ROI models, presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level, and guiding delivery teams as the lead architect
At least one current associate- or professional-level cloud certification (for example, AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect)  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Professional- or expert-tier and multi-cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience in a consulting, professional services, or systems integrator setting delivering cloud work for enterprise clients
* Familiarity with hybrid and on-premises-to-cloud platforms (VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, AWS Outposts, Azure Stack/Arc, Google Distributed Cloud)
* Deeper specialization in agentic AI, such as multi-agent systems, agent orchestration and governance (AgentOps), retrieval-augmented generation, and integrating large language models into enterprise workflows and platforms
* Experience mentoring architects and contributing reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards
* Industry or regulated-environment experience (financial services, public sector, healthcare), including data sovereignty and compliance considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Principal - Cloud Platform Engineer – Storage / Backup
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Cloud Platform Engineer - Storage/Backup builds and runs Storage and Backup Services as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within those services, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as a Storage/Backup Engineer and/or Architect
* Deep understanding of Storage systems, data protection software and cloud native storage services undefined
* Understanding of modern storage and backup technologies (Caching Services, Object Storage, distributed storage, SDS, Continuous Data Protection, Storage-as-a-service, Backup-as-a-service) undefined
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.  

  

**Desirable:**

* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* undefined
* Familiarity and hands on with Traditional Storage and Backup Technologies (SAN, Netapp OnTap, Avamar)
* undefined
* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.
* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Backup Servers, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Object Storage, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Storage Services, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

* Demonstrate sound judgment in technology decisions through due diligence, risk assessment, business-impact evaluation, and lifecycle planning.

Identify, evaluate, and recommend competitive and/or new alternative data integration technologies and products which further the enterprise application and data strategy.  

**Skills / Qualifications:**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.

Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE

* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 Years and Typically 6-8 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Strong experience as DevOps, Cloud Engineering / Architecture
* Deep expertise in Windows Server and/or Linux Operating Systems
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

  

* Azure, AWS, and GCP certifications
* undefined
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts

  

* Knowledge of cloud cost methodology.

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevSecOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Mainframe CICS & MQ System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe MQ System Programmer responsible for the installation, administration, support, performance tuning, security, automation, and high availability of IBM MQ for z/OS environments. The successful candidate will work closely with application development, infrastructure, operations, security, and architecture teams to design, implement, and maintain enterprise messaging solutions supporting mission-critical business applications across global environments.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain IBM MQ for z/OS environments, ensuring secure, stable, and highly available messaging services.
* Administer MQ Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Clusters, Queue Sharing Groups, and related infrastructure components across enterprise environments.
* Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, perform capacity planning, and optimize MQ environments for reliability, scalability, and business growth.
* Troubleshoot complex MQ infrastructure and application messaging issues, conduct root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of production incidents.
* Design and support high-availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions, including Sysplex and multi-region architectures.
* Implement and maintain MQ security controls, including RACF integration, SSL/TLS configurations, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Develop automation, scripting, and monitoring solutions to improve operational efficiency, incident response, and proactive system management.
* Architect and enhance MQ infrastructure solutions, providing technical leadership for modernization, clustering, workload balancing, and hybrid integration initiatives.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, and system programming teams to support application onboarding, deployments, migrations, and messaging connectivity solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and recovery plans while participating in change management, audits, and knowledge-sharing activities.
Provide on-call support in a 24x7 production environment, responding to critical incidents and supporting maintenance activities as needed.  

  
  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills**

  

* 5+ years of IBM MQ for z/OS System Programming experience
* IBM MQ for z/OS administration, including Queue Managers, QSGs, MQ Clusters, and Distributed Queueing
* Strong experience with MQ Channel Administration, Publish/Subscribe, and Workload Balancing
* Solid understanding of z/OS system programming, SMP/E, JES2, TSO/ISPF, JCL, USS, and SDSF
* Experience with MQ monitoring and performance tools such as OMEGAMON, MainView, and SYSVIEW
* Knowledge of RACF, MQ security, SSL/TLS, digital certificates, and compliance controls
* Proficiency in automation using REXX and tools such as SA z/OS, OPS/MVS, and NetView
* Expertise in troubleshooting, including dump/trace analysis, SMF analysis, and performance tuning
Strong incident management and root cause analysis skills  

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise MQ environments and Queue Sharing Groups (QSGs)
* Knowledge of Parallel Sysplex, high-availability, and disaster recovery architectures
* Familiarity with CICS, DB2, IMS, and other mainframe subsystems
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills; ITIL certification preferred  

  

**Key Competencies**

  

* Problem Solving & RCA
* Leadership & Mentoring
* Customer Focus
* Global Team Collaboration
* Change & Release Management
* Automation & Continuous Improvement
Operational Excellence & Resilience under Pressure  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Lead Platform Engineer AWS
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY**

Q2 is seeking a highly motivated **Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud Platform (AWS)** to lead the engineering, operations, and continuous improvement of highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure supporting our mission-critical financial services platform.

As a **technical lead** within the Platform Engineering organization, you will drive the adoption of Platform Engineering principles, champion automation, and build resilient cloud-native infrastructure with **AWS as the primary cloud platform**. You will also contribute to Azure-based initiatives as business needs evolve and should be comfortable working in a multi-cloud environment. Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is a plus.

You will collaborate closely with Product Engineering, DevOps, Security, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to build reliable platform services, improve developer productivity, and deliver secure, scalable cloud solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Lead & Engineering**

* Serve as the technical lead for cloud platform engineering initiatives.

* Drive the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cloud platform services.

* Define engineering standards, platform best practices, and technical roadmaps.

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across Platform Engineering teams.

* Lead technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and implementation planning.

* Drive cloud modernization and automation.

**Cloud Platform Engineering**

* Design, build, and operate secure, scalable, and highly available AWS infrastructure.

* Support Azure platform engineering initiatives and contribute to multi-cloud solutions as business needs evolve.

* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is desirable but not required.

* Design and manage AWS networking services including **VPC, Route 53, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Network ACLs, NAT Gateways, Internet Gateways, VPNs, Direct Connect, and Application/Network Load Balancers (ALB/NLB).**

* Build and operate Kubernetes platforms (**Amazon EKS preferred; AKS experience is beneficial**).

* Manage container platforms including **Docker, Amazon ECR (or equivalent container registries), container image lifecycle management, and artifact repositories.**

* Design secure multi-account cloud environments with IAM, governance, networking, and security best practices.

* Build reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.

* Develop self-service platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and reduce operational overhead.

* Optimize cloud performance, scalability, availability, and cost using FinOps best practices.

* Implement backup, disaster recovery, and high availability strategies.

**Automation & Platform Engineering**

* Develop platform automation using Python, Bash, or Go.

* Collaborate with DevOps and application engineering teams to integrate Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Kubernetes, and platform services into CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows.

* Promote GitOps practices and standardized deployment methodologies.

* Continuously improve platform automation and self-service capabilities.

**Observability & Operations**

* Design and implement end-to-end observability solutions using **OpenTelemetry****(****OTel****), Amazon CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch**, or similar platforms.

* Build monitoring, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting capabilities to improve platform visibility and reliability.

* Participate in an on-call rotation supporting business-critical production systems.

**Security & Governance**

* Implement AWS security best practices, IAM governance, encryption, and least-privilege access.

* Partner with Security teams to remediate vulnerabilities and maintain compliance.

* Support audit readiness, governance, and platform security initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or Infrastructure Engineering.

* 5+ years of experience with public cloud platforms, with **strong****expertise****in AWS**. Working knowledge of Azure is expected, and exposure to GCP is a plus.

* Strong expertise with AWS services including **EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS, ECS, S3, EBS, RDS, Route 53, CloudWatch, Auto Scaling, ALB/NLB, KMS, Transit Gateway, VPN, and Direct Connect.**

* Strong understanding of AWS networking architecture, hybrid connectivity, DNS, routing, load balancing, and security.

* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (**Amazon EKS preferred; AKS experience is beneficial**).

* Hands-on experience with **Docker, Amazon ECR (or equivalent container registries), container lifecycle management, and artifact repositories.**

* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform**.

* Experience integrating Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and platform automation into modern CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

* Strong scripting and programming skills using **Python, Bash, or Go.**

* Strong Linux administration experience.

* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability solutions using **OpenTelemetry****(****OTel****), CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog**, or similar technologies.

* Strong troubleshooting, production support, and incident management skills.

* Experience serving as a **technical lead**, providing engineering guidance, and driving cross-functional technical initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across AWS and Azure cloud environments.

* Experience with GitOps tools such as **ArgoCD** or **Flux**.

* Experience with service mesh technologies such as **Istio** or **Linkerd**.

* Experience with distributed systems such as **Kafka** or **Redis**.

* Knowledge of Policy-as-Code and cloud security automation.

* Experience implementing FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization.

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.

* AWS Professional Certification preferred.

* Azure and/or Google Cloud certifications are a plus.

* Kubernetes certifications (**CKA** or **CKS**) are a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Platform Engineering

* AWS Cloud Architecture

* Azure Cloud

* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS)

* Docker & Container Platforms

* AWS Networking

* Infrastructure as Code frameworks i.e. Terraform/Crossplane

* Automation & Scripting

* GitOps

* Observability (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch)

* Cloud Security & Governance

* Incident & Problem Management

* Operational Excellence

* Technical Leadership & Mentoring

* Cross-functional Collaboration

**Success Measures**

* Improve platform availability, reliability, and resiliency.

* Reduce operational toil through automation.

* Increase platform scalability and engineering efficiency.

* Optimize cloud performance and cost.

* Deliver secure, scalable, reusable platform services that improve the developer experience.

* Drive engineering excellence through technical guidance, automation, platform innovation, and operational best practices.

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
* Community Volunteering & Company Philanthropy Programs
* Employee Peer Recognition Programs – “You Earned it”

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. title: AD/Lead Consultant- Data Strategy and Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Company Overview
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve disease management, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We bring our best to our work — and we put people first. We’re looking for individuals who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
Responsibilities
  
The GOSO Data Strategy & AI Lead will report to the GOSO DSO Lead and play a critical role in defining and operationalizing GOSO’s centralized data and AI strategy. This role will architect the AI-ready data foundation required for agentic AI systems, machine learning pipelines, and advanced analytics across GOSO — with particular attention to the complexity and scale of US and International Business Unit (IBU) markets, affiliate data ecosystems, and cross-market harmonization challenges. This role will also lead and mentor a small team — developing talent across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations.
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Define and operationalize the GOSO-wide data and AI strategy in partnership with Tech@Lilly and GOSO Functional Teams (SFO, IC, DT), ensuring the platform supports next-generation AI/ML workloads including agentic AI, RAG, and semantic reasoning layers — while accounting for IBU-specific multi-market data heterogeneity and varying data maturity across geographies.
* Translate functional and business requirements into scalable Data Spine implementations on AWS/Databricks that support feature stores, semantic layers, and data contracts required by downstream ML and agentic AI systems — designing for IBU scalability with repeatable, templatized onboarding of new affiliate markets without bespoke rework.
* Architect data structures, semantic ontologies, and API-accessible data services that enable agentic AI capabilities — prioritizing use cases that address IBU-specific pain points like multi-market reconciliation and cross-geography performance benchmarking.
* Drive the design and deployment of production ML pipelines — from feature engineering and model training through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — establishing MLOps patterns (experiment tracking, model versioning, drift detection, automated retraining) that scale across both HQ and IBU workloads.
* Lead the design of multi-agent architectures where specialized AI agents operate within an orchestrated ecosystem with well-defined tool-use patterns, memory management, and human-in-the-loop escalation — ensuring agent designs are adaptable to US/IBU contexts where business rules and decision thresholds vary by market.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for T@L on all data and AI-related initiatives, ensuring aligned priorities, transparent execution, and a unified roadmap that accounts for platform evolution, emerging AI capabilities, and enterprise MLOps standards — while representing IBU requirements in enterprise-level planning.
* Drive AI literacy and adoption enablement across GOSO functional stakeholders — including IBU affiliate teams where AI readiness may vary significantly — ensuring predictable onboarding of new data assets, ML models, and agentic workflows into the GOSO ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual interventions and accelerate insight generation through ML-driven data quality monitoring, self-healing pipelines, and intelligent automation — with particular focus on eliminating repetitive market-by-market manual processes common in US/IBU operations.
* Develop, mentor, and coach a small team of analysts, data engineers, and AI practitioners — ensuring capability development across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations, with cross-functional exposure to data and AI domains.

Basic Qualifications / Technical Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields); advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial data engineering, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and/or applied AI/ML.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based data architectures and pharma commercial ecosystems — with a clear grasp of how data foundations enable ML and agentic AI at scale.
* Practical experience with Databricks (including Unity Catalog, MLflow, Feature Store, and/or Agent Bricks), AWS services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), and modern data engineering/AI best practices.
* Expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python (including ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain/LangGraph for agentic frameworks).
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes, semantic layer design, and experience with orchestration platforms such as AWS Glue or Databricks workflows.
* Hands-on MLOps experience — model versioning, experiment tracking, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and drift detection.
* Experience designing or deploying agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration, or tool-use agent architectures in a production or near-production setting.
* Ability to quickly assess upstream/downstream impacts for data, model, and system changes across interconnected analytics and AI workloads.
* Strong stakeholder management and prior experience operating in a matrixed global environment.

Additional Skills / Preferences
  
  
**IBU / International Commercial Domain (Strongly Preferred):**  

* Prior experience with International Business Unit or multi-affiliate pharma commercial operations — understanding of how data flows, vendor ecosystems, and commercial models differ across US and ex-US markets (Japan, Europe, Emerging Markets).
* Familiarity with IBU-specific data challenges: multi-vendor sourcing (IQVIA, local vendors), cross-country definition variability, affiliate-level sales/demand structures and market-specific compliance requirements.
* Experience with IBU/US commercial analytics domains such as incentive compensation, sales force operations, dynamic targeting, or demand forecasting in a multi-market context.
* Understanding of global vs. local data ownership models in a matrixed IBU environment — and how to design AI systems that respect affiliate context while enabling centralized intelligence

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.

This role is suited for a strong hands-on software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing modern applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments.

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features and services from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, integration, troubleshooting, and production readiness.

  

**Core Technical Qualifications**

The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience with most of the following:

* Modern full-stack application development

* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering

* RESTful APIs and backend service development

* .NET and C# development

* Microservices and distributed-system concepts

* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
* + RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology
* + SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms
* + Caching technologies such as Redis
* + Data-processing and persistence concepts
* + Authentication, authorization, and secure API design
* + Automated unit, API, component, and integration testing
* + Observability, structured logging, and production troubleshooting
* + Git-based development, branching, pull-request, and release workflows
* Strong hands-on experience with .NET/C# is particularly relevant to the existing platform-services landscape.

  **Experience Profile**

  + Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  + 5+ years of professional software-development experience, with substantial hands-on development responsibility.

  + Strong experience building production-quality backend, full-stack, or platform software.

  + Experience developing services using microservice, API-driven, and distributed-system architectures.

  + Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  + Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features.

  + Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments.

  **Preferred / Differentiating Experience**

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

  + Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms

  + Edge computing or appliance-based software

  + Hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud platforms

  + Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments

  + Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems

  + Kubernetes-based edge deployments

  + Time-series databases

  + Device and gateway management

  + Secure software-development lifecycle practices

  

* Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components.

* Implement well-defined service interfaces, APIs, contracts, and reusable abstractions.

* Develop event-driven services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies and asynchronous processing patterns.

* Build services interacting with relational databases, time-series data stores, caching technologies, and file/object storage.

* Implement reliable service-to-service communication, error handling, retry, and integration patterns.

* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services and their dependencies.

* Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments.

* Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations.

* Apply abstraction and adapter patterns where needed to minimize unnecessary cloud-provider dependencies.

* Develop software capable of operating in Cognition edge/appliance environments, including deployments with limited or restricted connectivity.

* Build platform components with appropriate consideration for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization.

* Develop and support services deployed in Kubernetes-based environments.

* Contribute to installation, configuration, upgrade, and lifecycle-management capabilities for platform services.

* Follow engineering and security requirements associated with regulated, restricted-connectivity, or air-gapped deployments.

**Engineering & Collaboration Expectations**

* Take ownership of assigned features, services, and technical problems with limited supervision.

* Translate technical designs and requirements into high-quality working software.

* Participate constructively in architecture and design discussions.

* Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain engineering standards.

* Collaborate effectively with technical leads, architects, Product Owners, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, and application teams.

* Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early.

* Diagnose technical issues spanning applications, services, messaging, databases, Kubernetes, and infrastructure.

* Contribute to technical investigations and proof-of-concepts for new technologies or platform capabilities.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Oracle Cloud SCM Functional Architect
description:
**SCM Functional Architect – Oracle Fusion based Enterprise Supply Chain Transformation**

We are looking for an experienced **SCM Functional Architect** to lead large-scale, enterprise Supply Chain transformation programs built on **Oracle Fusion Cloud**. This is a senior role suited for professionals who combine deep Supply Chain Execution and Planning expertise with strong ERP design capability, and who can operate as a trusted advisor to SCM leadership.

The role will focus on designing integrated Supply chain processes across **Inventory, Product Data Hub (PDH/PIM/PLM), Costing, Procurement, Order Management, Pricing, Supply and Demand Planning.** A key expectation is the ability to translate complex Supply Chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions, ensuring that SCM processes are not implemented in isolation but are aligned across all modules of supply chain

Experience in identifying and solutioning the KDDs must. Especially formation of Procurement organization structure, Inventory Org structure, Costing methods. Should be well conversant with best practices for various Industry Verticals.

Given the global nature of the program, the role requires a solid understanding of how the global design workshops are conducted and formalize the Global template along with identification of **l**ocalizations. The architect will ensure solutions are globally standardized while still supporting necessary regional variations.

Equally important is the ability to articulate business impact. The role requires translating design into measurable business outcomes, including KPIs and enhanced SCM visibility. The architect will play a central role in shaping and governing the **value realization framework**, ensuring that transformation objectives are achieved and sustained.

Candidates must bring strong SCM credentials, preferably **B. Tech or MBA in SCM, logistics or Operations**, combined with a minimum of **15+ years** of experience in SCM transformation programs. Experience in domain like Manufacturing, Procurement etc is advantage. Proven experience in **Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM** is essential.

This role is intended for professionals who can go beyond ERP implementation and act as design authorities—ensuring that finance transformation delivers business outcomes, not just system changes.

title: Package Layout Design Staff/Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

The Marvell Advanced Packaging team is responsible for package designs  
that meet challenging electrical requirements. High speed signaling and challenging power delivery networks require complex and custom solutions to meet constantly advancing application needs. Many of the new designs require multi-chip and multiple component configurations with high-speed IP requirements. In addition, our team is advancing Marvell's expertise in 3D packaging, Co-packaged optics and cutting-edge substrate materials. We work with the world's leading manufacturers to solve our client's most challenging designs and integrations with industry-leading packaging techniques.

**What You Can Expect**

**What You Can Expect**

* Marvell’s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
* The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.

**What We're Looking For**

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 4+ years of related professional experience.

* Proficiency with industry-standard IC package layout tools such as Cadence APD or Siemens (Mentor) Xpedition (XPD)
* Strong understanding of IC package design requirements for high-speed interfaces, including constraints definition and implementation
* Experience collaborating with substrate suppliers, OSATs, and silicon fabrication partners to drive successful design execution
* Expertise in power plane design, including translating system-level power delivery requirements into optimized package solutions
* Knowledge of IC packaging technologies, materials, substrate design rules, and assembly constraints
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI) from concept through development and production is a plus
* Ability to collaborate with ASIC physical design teams to optimize die floorplan for improved package integration and system performance is a plus
* Knowledge of 2D, 2.5D, and emerging packaging architectures such as CoWoS‑S/R/L, EMIB, CPO, and CPC.
* High‑level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e.g., warpage, TIM).
* Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
* Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
* Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

With competitive compensation and great benefits, you will enjoy our workstyle within an environment of shared collaboration, transparency, and inclusivity. We’re dedicated to giving our people the tools and resources they need to succeed in doing work that matters, and to grow and develop with us. For additional information on what it’s like to work at Marvell, visit our Careers page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

**Interview Integrity**

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Mainframe zOS Administration Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-class z/OS storage solutions to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Lead the architecture and governance of DFSMS and SMS environments, including Storage Groups, Data Classes, Storage Classes, Management Classes, and ACS routines.
* Manage DASD capacity planning, storage optimization, hardware upgrades, and long-term growth strategies.
* Administer and support VTOC, VTOCIX, catalogs, DFSMShsm, and DFSMSdss, ensuring efficient data lifecycle management and recoverability.
* Monitor storage performance, analyze I/O workloads, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive root cause resolution for critical incidents.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities across the storage environment.
* Collaborate with security teams to maintain compliance with audit, regulatory, and access control requirements.
* Lead strategic initiatives including storage modernization, hardware refreshes, data center migrations, z/OS upgrades, cloud integration, automation, and disaster recovery enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, JCL, ISPF, and vendor tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for storage-related issues, providing expert guidance and operational leadership.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams to deliver storage services that align with business objectives.
Mentor junior engineers and system programmers, promote knowledge sharing, and contribute to the development of standards, procedures, and best practices.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 10+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
