title: IT Engineer,Software,Expert
description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities:

**Platform Optimization & Org Health**

* Hunt down technical debt — dead automations, bloated triggers, redundant fields, and queries that scan half the database for one record.
* Audit and rationalize automations into a single, sane framework. No more “which of the five automations on this object actually fires first?” mysteries.
* Monitor org health proactively — governor limits, storage, API consumption, deployment stability — using Salesforce Optimizer, Event Monitoring, and custom dashboards you build yourself.

**Development & Code Quality**

* Build production-grade Apex — bulkified, governor-limit-aware, single-trigger-per-object, with proper separation of concerns (service/selector/domain layers).
* Develop Lightning Web Components that are reusable, accessible
* Hold the quality bar in code reviews — meaningful test assertions (not just coverage farming), no hardcoded IDs, clean error handling, sensible naming.
* Own and improve the CI/CD pipeline — scratch orgs, source-driven development, automated test gates, and deployments that don’t need a war room.

**Integration & Data Management**

* Design and maintain integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture — with proper retry logic, error handling, and idempotency.
* Champion data quality — deduplication strategies, validation rules that actually help, and migration practices that don’t create a cleanup project of their own.
* Troubleshoot sync failures and API limit issues across connected systems before they become someone’s escalation.

**Collaboration & Best Practices Enablement**

* Define and document development standards and best practices — then make sure the team actually follows them.
* Mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews, and knowledge sharing — not lectures.
* Evaluate every Salesforce release (three per year) for features worth adopting and deprecations worth addressing.
* Help the team make smart clicks-vs-code decisions so the org stays maintainable as it grows.

Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 9–15 years of hands-on Salesforce platform development — cloud-agnostic, problem-first.
* Active Salesforce certifications preferred — Platform Developer I/II, Application Architect, System Architect, or any specialist certification.
* Clear communicator who can explain a complex technical tradeoff to a business stakeholder without their eyes glazing over.

**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Deep hands-on skills in Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, and enough Visualforce knowledge to maintain legacy components.
* Strong JavaScript/ES6+, HTML, and CSS fundamentals.
* Expertise in Salesforce’s security architecture — profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS, OWDs, role hierarchy.
* Solid Git workflow habits — branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution.
* Proficiency with Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, metadata API, and at least one CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Copado, Gearset).
* Sharp debugging instincts — Debug Logs, Query Plan tool, Limit monitoring, and the patience to trace a bug through five layers of automation.
* Familiarity with data migration/ETL tools — Data Loader, Dataloader.io, or equivalent.
* Comfortable in Agile/Scrum rhythms without needing a ceremony for every decision.

**Good to** **h****ave****AI Exposure**

* Understanding of AI/ML fundamentals — supervised vs unsupervised learning, model training, evaluation metrics, and data pipelines.
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) — prompt engineering, fine-tuning concepts, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and API-based integrations.
* Familiarity with generative AI use cases in enterprise contexts — summarization, classification, content generation, conversational bots, and intelligent search.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools for code generation, test scaffolding, or automated code review.
* Basic comfort with Python or similar languages for scripting AI/ML workflows, data wrangling, or prototyping.
* Awareness of responsible AI principles — bias, explainability, data privacy, and governance considerations.

Careers Privacy Statement\*\*\*Keysight is an Equal Opportunity Employer.\*\*\*

title: Senior Software Engineering - Ag & Trading
description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

The Senior Software Engineering - Ag & Trading **for AI Assistants & Agents in AI & Data Science** builds services to operate Cargill’s portfolio of GenAI Assistants and Agents - including ChatGPT-powered copilots and bespoke LLM services. You will translate product requirements into secure, efficient, and observable services and or agents; manage the lifecycle from experiment to production; and continually improve reliability, latency, and cost. Typical deliverables span REST services, vector-search back end, LLMOps & AgentOps pipelines, and rich front-end components for knowledge workers and plant operators. Expect to collaborate daily with product managers, data scientists, cloud engineers, and security teams while acting as the technical authority for GenAI feature design and launch.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

* **Design & Build**
  + Develop multi-agent workflow automation patterns using Agentic AI
  + Process redesign and mapping to agentic workflow patterns
  + Architect scalable micro-services that wrap LLM/RAG/Agent workflows (Python).
  + Implement robust prompt-engineering patterns, retrieval pipelines, and caching for AI Assistants and AI Agents
* **Platform Ops**
  + Extend evaluation, automated testing, canary rollout, and rollback for AgentOps.
  + Profile inference latency, GPU/CPU utilization, and memory; deliver quarterly cost-to-serve reductions
  + Lead bug-fix, security-patch, and performance-tuning sprints for live AI Assistants and AI Agents
* **Operational Excellence**
  + Own on-call runbooks, SLOs, and incident reviews; embed observability
  + Enforce Responsible-AI guardrails, data-privacy controls, and vulnerability-management policies for AI Assistants and AI agents
* **Enablement & Mentoring**
  + Coach full-stack and data-science peers on GenAI/LLMOps patterns; create internal workshops and tech blogs.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Minimum:** 4 years building production software or data platforms .
* **Typical:** 5–8 years, including 2+ years with cloud-native AI/ML or GenAI systems (Azure, AWS, or GCP) or 2+ years of software devlopment
* Experience building and scaling full-stack applications using the following languages/frameworks: React & typescript, Java (Spring Boot) and/or Python

  Preferred:

  + Experience building AI solutions, working with AI tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.
  + Experience with building applications that use large language models or other AI services
  + Working with AI coding assistants or agentic development tools
  + Strong foundation in relational databases, with hands‑on experience using PostgreSQL
  + Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps delivery practices
  + Experience deploying and operating applications on cloud‑native platforms
  + Proficiency with Git‑based version control and collaborative development workflows
  + Understanding of modern application architectures, cloud‑native patterns, and security best practices

title: Digital Technology Specialist - Product Security
description:
**Digital Technology Specialist - Product Security**

**Do you enjoy programming and leading a team which builds and supports securing products?**

**Would you like to be part of a successful team?**

**Join our Team.**

Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward, making it safer, cleaner, and more efficient for people and the planet.

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Security Engineer to help secure our software products and development ecosystem. This role is responsible for identifying and mitigating security risks throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), partnering with engineering teams to build secure-by-design products, and advancing security practices for AI-assisted software development.

The ideal candidate combines strong offensive security skills with practical software engineering knowledge and hands-on experience across application security testing, secure coding, open-source security, and container security.

**Partner with the best**

As a Digital Technology Specialist - Product Security, you will be responsible for:

**Application & Product Security**

* Perform penetration testing and application vulnerability assessments on web, API, cloud, and containerized applications.
* Identify, validate, prioritize, and communicate security vulnerabilities to development teams.
* Conduct threat modelling and security design reviews for new products and features.
* Drive remediation efforts and provide secure coding guidance to engineering teams.

**Secure SDLC & DevSecOps**

* Embed security controls throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
* Partner with developers, architects, and DevOps teams to implement security by design.
* Integrate and optimize security tooling within CI/CD pipelines.
* Support security automation and policy-as-code initiatives.

**Application Security Testing**

* Execute and interpret results from:
  + Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
  + Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
  + Software Composition Analysis (OSS/SCA)
  + Container Security Scanning
  + Secret Detection and Code Scanning
* Triage findings, reduce false positives, and drive risk-based remediation.

**AI Security & AI-SSDLC**

* Assess security risks introduced by AI-assisted development and AI-enabled applications.
* Support implementation of AI Secure SDLC (AI-SSDLC) practices.
* Evaluate AI-generated code for security weaknesses and unsafe design patterns.
* Contribute to AI threat modelling, agent security, prompt security, and secure AI development guardrails.
* Stay current on emerging risks related to LLMs, AI agents, model abuse, and AI supply chain security.

**Developer Enablement**

* Deliver security coaching, training, and awareness sessions for development teams.
* Create actionable security guidance, standards, and best practices.
* Champion a security-first culture across product engineering teams.

**Required Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or related field.

* 5-8 years of experience in Application Security, Product Security, Penetration Testing, or Secure Software Engineering.
* Strong understanding of modern software development practices and SDLC.
* Experience performing manual and automated penetration testing.
* Experience securing cloud-native and containerized applications.
* Strong programming or scripting skills in one or more languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, Go, or C++.
* Deep understanding of common vulnerabilities including OWASP Top 10 and API security risks.

**Technical Skills :**

  

**Security Testing**

* SAST tools (Checkmarx, Coverity, Fortify, Veracode, CodeQL)
* DAST tools (Burp Suite, AppScan, Veracode, OWASP ZAP)
* OSS/SCA tools (Black Duck, Mend, Snyk, Dependency-Check)
* Container security platforms (Prisma Cloud, Wiz, Aqua, Trivy)

**Cloud & DevSecOps**

* GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins
* CI/CD security controls
* Kubernetes and container platforms
* Infrastructure as Code security

**AI Security**

* AI Secure SDLC
* LLM and Agent security concepts
* Prompt injection and model misuse risks
* Secure AI application development
* AI supply chain security and model governance

**Work in a way that works for you.**

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

* Working remotely from home or any other office location, provided you visit the office when needed.
* Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit in everything in and work when you are the most productive.

**Working with us**

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

Your Team, Your Impact  
  
Within this ecosystem, Marvell’s central advanced packaging organization plays a critical role in delivering next generation connectivity and compute products. The organization brings deep expertise in architecture, package design, and electrical performance, including SI/PI to develop advanced IC packages that support high speed interfaces. This work directly shapes product performance, reliability, and time to market, making it a key contributor to Marvell’s overall technology leadership.

**What You Can Expect**

**What You Can Expect**

* Marvell’s Central Engineering team is seeking a talented High-speed IC package development engineer to contribute to the development of advanced microelectronic packages.
* The engineer will be responsible for driving microelectronic package development from concept through tapeout, working with package architects and technical leads to select appropriate technologies and ensure manufacturability, performance, reliability, and cost compliance.
* Key responsibilities include developing C4 and BGA ball maps optimized for SI/PI and layout efficiency; planning and validating netlist mappings across dies, interposers, and substrates; and defining die placement, padstacks, net assignments, and package‑level connectivity.
* The engineer will create and maintain Package Requirement Documents (PRDs) detailing die arrangements, stackups, and design constraints.

**What We're Looking For**

**What We're Looking For**

  

* 8+ years of related professional experience.

* Previous experience developing netlists and schematics for large, complex packages.
* Previous experience developing C4 and BGA ball maps for high‑pin‑count designs.
* Proficiency with design tools Cadence OrbitIO / Integrity System Planner (ISP) or equivalent
* Strong foundational understanding of package design, including design rules, breakout, place and route, signal shielding, reference planes, power distribution, and pinout optimization across package and system requirements.
* Solid grasp of SI/PI fundamentals at the substrate, board, and system levels; familiarity with running and interpreting signal and power simulations is a plus.
* Knowledge of 2D, 2.5D, and emerging packaging architectures such as CoWoS‑S/R/L, EMIB, CPO, and CPC.
* High‑level understanding of thermal and mechanical package constraints (e.g., warpage, TIM).
* Experience contributing to tool, process, and flow development, including library maintenance and basic scripting for automation.
* Familiarity with foundry design rules and substrate manufacturing constraints.
* Demonstrated ability to work across cross‑functional teams and global time zones; strong interpersonal skills and willingness to learn.
* Experience collaborating with chip and board design and electrical simulation teams to optimize package and system co‑design.
* Experience collaborating with chip and board design, and electrical simulation teams for co‑design and optimization.
* Strong communication, presentation, and documentation skills.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**

Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.

**Who You Are:**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do:**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. title: Senior AI API Platform Engineer
description:

------------------

The AI API Platform Engineer is a hands-on technical lead who designs and builds the APIs and platform capabilities powering Rubrik's AI-driven products and automation, owning the full API lifecycle across any stack, cloud, or iPaaS. This role delivers secure, scalable, high-performance APIs and full-stack services while enabling AI-native consumption patterns across the enterprise.

* **Define API governance** - versioning, documentation standards, and reusable auth/error-handling/observability frameworks.

* **Drive reuse and standardizatio**n through shared APIs, connectors, SDKs, and an integration catalog.
* **Evaluate emerging patterns** (event-driven integration, AI agent frameworks, low-code automation) to shape the platform roadmap.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Experience**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with 5+ years in API/full-stack/backend development across multiple languages and clouds.
* 2+ years in a senior/lead/architect capacity owning API and platform designs for complex, enterprise-scale systems.
* 1+ years in an FDE role, working directly with internal customers.

### **Technical Skills - API, Fullstack & Backend**

* **Deep API expertise across** REST, including contract-first design (OpenAPI/Swagger) and robust error handling.
* **Strong backend and full-stack skills** in Node.js / Java / Python / Go, plus platform-agnostic experience across cloud and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Workato, Boomi).

### **Technical Skills - AI & Intelligent Platform Enablement**

* **Hands-on experience with the AI-assisted SDLC** - using AI tools to design, build, test, and manage APIs.
* **Experience building APIs for AI consumption**, including function/tool-calling interfaces for LLMs and agents.
* **Working knowledge of AI/LLM frameworks** (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) and vector databases, and how they integrate with enterprise APIs.
* **Understanding of AI-specific NFRs** - latency, cost, rate limiting, and safety/guardrails.
* **Practical experience with AI coding assistants** (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for AI assisted platform and infrastructure development.

**Soft Skills**

* Define standards for partitioning, file sizes, schema evolution, incremental processing, data retention, and performance optimization.

* Define strategies for managing historical data, slowly changing dimensions, data retention, and archival.

* Define security patterns for row-level security, column-level security, masking, encryption, secrets management, and secure data access.
* Establish data ownership, data stewardship, metadata, lineage, and data quality standards.

title: Principal DFT design Engineer

title: Senior Identity Engineer - IT Risk and Security
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** As Senior Identity Engineer for IT Risk and Security, you will be a senior hands-on engineer responsible for operating, improving, automating, securing and troubleshooting the enterprise identity platforms the firm depends on. The estate of platforms include Identity Providers, legacy directory services, enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. This is a senior individual contributor role, not an architect role — the ideal candidate is deeply hands-on, comfortable owning complex, ambiguous identity problems end to end with minimal supervision, and raises the standard of the engineers around them. Experience working in a regulated financial environment is a plus.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

* Design, build and operate identity services across core identity provider platforms—Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta—including authentication journeys, application integration, federation and single sign-on at scale; implement, test, troubleshoot and monitor access policies, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, authentication strengths, session controls, policy exclusions and emergency access safeguards.
* Operate and troubleshoot Active Directory in large, complex, multi-domain and multi-forest environments, including domain controllers, DNS and name resolution, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts and cross-domain authentication, service accounts, privileged groups, delegated access and domain health; coordinate changes across dependent systems.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex identity incidents — authentication failures, provisioning issues, certificate-related outages, privileged access problems and production change failures — determining cause, escalating anything with ongoing or immediate impact, performing root cause analysis and driving the problem to a permanent fix.
* Plan, execute, validate and document production identity changes, including risk assessment, implementation steps, rollback planning, stakeholder coordination, functional and connectivity testing, and post-change monitoring.
* Grow the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle — provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, and policy and role-based entitlement in place of ticket-by-ticket approval.
* Support PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services — TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Automate repeatable identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, source control and pipeline-based workflows, applying configuration-as-code to identity change rather than manual administration.
* Develop group policies and access control lists, design and build system administration and management functionality for privileged access users, maintain baseline system security, and resolve vulnerabilities in identity systems and components through documented remediation plans.
* Maintain the resilience of the service: define availability levels, determine disaster recovery and continuity of operations requirements, and develop, test and execute recovery and alternate-site procedures for identity platforms.
* Own operational documentation for the identity services you support — SOPs, runbooks, implementation records, troubleshooting guides, escalation procedures, known-error documentation and workflow diagrams — kept current with the deployed design and to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.
* Produce audit-ready evidence for identity controls — privileged access, access reviews, account lifecycle events, group membership, policy changes, app permissions, certificate ownership and remediation actions — supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, defending design decisions and closing findings to agreed dates.
* Collect metrics and trending data, develop cybersecurity and performance success metrics, and examine service performance reports for issues and variances so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
* Mentor and upskill engineers across the team through code and design reviews, interactive training and knowledge transfer, building genuine cover so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
* Establish internal and external cross-team relationships — with security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and application teams — to gather requirements, translate proposed capabilities into technical requirements and deliver identity solutions that meet business needs.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
* 5+ years in identity and access management in a hands-on engineering or operations role, with a track record of independently delivering complex identity change in a large, distributed estate; experience in financial services a plus.
* Deep, current, hands-on experience operating Active Directory in large, complex environments — domain controllers, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, privileged groups and domain health troubleshooting — including multi-domain or multi-forest estates with cross-domain authentication and delegated access.
* Equivalent depth in Microsoft Entra ID — tenant configuration, directory synchronization, conditional access, privileged role management, entitlement models, enterprise applications and app registrations — and in Okta, covering policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication, authorization, federation, directory synchronization, MFA, Conditional Access, certificates, DNS, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SCIM.
* Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services, including TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience governing non-human identities — service accounts, managed identities, app registrations, API clients and automation accounts — including secrets and certificate handling, ownership records, permission reviews and decommissioning.
* Strong automation ability using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, including the Okta management APIs, with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration-as-code applied to identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation.
* Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance.
* Expert command of change management process and discipline; you are expected to plan, document and execute high-risk identity change on production platforms with minimal guidance, including rollback planning and post-change validation.
* Demonstrated operational engineering discipline: incident, problem and change management, root cause analysis, service level reporting, and the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, runbooks and known-error documentation.
* Direct experience supporting identity controls through audit — preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
* Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, sufficient to explain identity design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, answer requests for information directly, and communicate critical or time-sensitive information to leadership.
* Experience with a cohesive PAM/IGA program

**What makes you stand out**:

* You have an engineer's instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable carrying live service ownership and a delivery backlog at the same time.
* You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs — Entra ID or Okta — rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
* You are the person others escalate to, and you close the loop by documenting what you found so the next engineer does not have to rediscover it.
* You leave the estate better documented and better understood than you found it, and you deliberately build capability in the engineers around you.
* You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.
* Education / Certification Requirements:
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) preferred.
* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred; Okta Certified Consultant a plus.
* CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.
* Significant experience with demonstrated examples of growing PAM and/or IGA programs
* Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign-on, and multi-factor or passwordless authentication.

**Working environment**:

* Team distributed across UK, US and GCC locations; **expected business start time (2:00 - 2:30 PM IST) to overlap some of US business hours** and participation in an escalation and on-call rotation should be expected.
* 4 days' a week in office.

**Your role**

title: Software Dev Engineer III, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running — supporting all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer III to join our Infrastructure Supply Chain team, building large-scale distributed systems that power one of the world's most complex physical supply chains. Our systems manage hundreds of thousands of rack demands annually across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions — from demand forecasting and material planning to manufacturing execution, logistics, and data center deployment.  
  
These are greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up using modern technologies including reactive microservices, serverless computing, and distributed NoSQL data stores.  
  
What You'll Do  
Own and drive the technical vision for highly scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems that support the end-to-end infrastructure supply chain — spanning demand planning, fulfillment, manufacturing, logistics, and DC readiness  
Solve complex, ambiguous architecture and business problems, delivering extensible solutions that operate at AWS scale while influencing long-term technical strategy  
Write high-quality, modular, functional, and testable code with a focus on operational excellence, and raise the bar for engineering standards across the team  
Lead cross-functional initiatives with supply chain planners, hardware engineers, and operations managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions, driving alignment across multiple teams  
Formally mentor and develop mid-level and junior engineers on system design, coding best practices, architecture patterns, and troubleshooting — acting as a technical role model  
Drive and own the full software development lifecycle — from design and code reviews through testing, deployment, and operations — with a focus on continuous improvement and operational rigor  
Lead innovation in areas such as demand forecasting, supply optimization, and end-to-end observability through the Infrastructure Control Tower  
Influence team roadmap and technical direction, contributing to org-level planning and prioritization  
Basic Qualifications  
5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience  
4+ years of non-internship design or architecture experience (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) of new and existing systems  
Experience programming with at least one modern software programming language (Java, Python, TypeScript, or equivalent)  
Strong understanding of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and system design principles  
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects end-to-end, including defining architecture, driving consensus, and delivering results across teams  
Preferred Qualifications  
5+ years of full software development lifecycle experience, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations  
Proven track record of building distributed systems, microservices architectures, or event-driven platforms at scale  
Deep expertise with AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, ECS/EKS)  
Experience with supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing domain systems  
Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar within a team or organization  
Track record of influencing technical strategy beyond immediate team scope  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent; Master's degree preferred  
Why Join Us  
Greenfield opportunity — Build from scratch with modern technologies and define the architecture from day one  
Massive scale — Work on systems that manage 130+ hardware categories, global manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and data center deployments worldwide  
High impact — Every rack you help deliver powers the AWS services that millions of customers depend on  
Career growth — Endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources to help you grow into a principal engineer or technical leader  
About the Team  
We value diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.  
  
We value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The Key Job Responsibilities section now covers 10 areas:  
  
Design & Build Scalable Systems — end-to-end supply chain applications  
Solve Complex Architecture Problems — translating ambiguous requirements into solutions  
Write Production-Quality Code — modular, testable, operationally excellent  
Own the Full Development Lifecycle — design through production, including on-call  
Build Supply Chain Domain Expertise — S&OP, VMI, SFGs, fulfillment pipeline, DC readiness  
Contribute to System Design & Technical Strategy — design reviews, architecture decisions  
Mentor & Develop Junior Engineers — formal mentorship of SDE Is  
Collaborate Cross-Functionally — work with planners, hardware engineers, PMs globally  
Drive Operational Excellence — monitoring, alerting, runbooks, proactive risk mitigation  
Innovate & Automate — ML-powered forecasting, intelligent observability, automation  
  
About the team  
As an SDE III on the Infrastructure Supply Chain team, your typical day will include a mix of deep technical work, collaboration, and continuous learning:  
  
Morning Stand-up & Sprint Planning — Start the day with your agile team to review progress, discuss blockers, and align on sprint priorities across supply chain workstreams  
Design & Architecture Sessions — Participate in or lead design reviews for new features — such as a new fulfillment pipeline stage tracker or a demand forecasting data ingestion service  
Heads-Down Coding — Spend focused blocks writing, refactoring, and testing code for distributed microservices, serverless functions, and API integrations that power supply chain workflows  
Code Reviews — Review pull requests from teammates, providing constructive feedback on design patterns, edge cases, performance, and operational readiness  
Debugging & Troubleshooting — Investigate production issues using CloudWatch dashboards, X-Ray traces, and Control Tower observability tools to identify root causes and deploy fixes  
Cross-Team Collaboration — Join working sessions with supply chain planners, hardware engineers, or logistics teams to clarify requirements, demo features, or align on data contracts  
Mentoring — Pair-program with junior engineers, walk through design approaches on a whiteboard, or review their design documents to help them grow technically  
Operational Reviews — Monitor service health metrics, review alarms, update runbooks, and participate in weekly operational excellence reviews to maintain a high availability bar  
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing — Write or update design documents, API specs, and wiki pages; present tech talks or brown-bag sessions to share learnings with the broader team  
Innovation & Experimentation — Dedicate time to explore new approaches — prototyping an ML-based anomaly detector for dwell time spikes, evaluating a new AWS service for event-driven workflows, or contributing to team hackathon projects

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Technical Architect – AWS AI Architect
description:
Experience: 12+ Years

**Role Summary**

* Architect agentic solutions end to end: task decomposition, tool/function design, memory and state models, orchestration topology (supervisor, hierarchical, sequential, parallel), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* + Design and tune production RAG pipelines — chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, query rewriting, metadata filtering, grounding and citation — and own the retrieval quality metrics, not just the pipeline diagram.
* + Build the evaluation layer alongside the system: golden datasets, trace-level assertions, LLM-as-judge rubrics, regression suites that gate deployment.
* + Select and justify the AWS service composition for each workload, with an explicit view on cost, latency, data residency, and failure modes.
* + Define guardrails and the security posture for agents that take real actions: least-privilege tool permissions, prompt injection defenses, PII handling, audit trails.
* + Set engineering standards for the practice — reference architectures, reusable agent and tool patterns, observability conventions — and mentor engineers into them.
* + Partner with client stakeholders on solution shaping, technical discovery, effort estimation, and proof-of-value scoping.

**Why This Role Matters**

Agentic AI systems fail in production for predictable reasons: unmanaged context windows, brittle orchestration, unscoped tool permissions, and no observability into why an agent did what it did. This role exists to prevent that — designing agent architectures on AWS (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) that are secure by default, cost-bounded, evaluable, and built to scale past the POC stage

**What You’ll Do**

We are seeking a strong AWS AI architect with hands-on expertise with At least two agentic or RAG systems taken to production on AWS, with evidence of ownership through the operate phase — not pilots that stopped at demo**.**

**Must-Have Skills**

2-3 year experience in Agentic system design Planning and execution loops, ReAct and plan-execute patterns, tool/function calling design, short- and long-term memory, state persistence and recovery, multi-agent orchestration and handoff design, MCP and A2A for tool and agent interoperability. Practical judgment on when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic workflow is the right one.

2-3 year experience in Agent frameworks Deep hands-on experience with at least two of: Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex. Comfortable dropping to a custom orchestration loop where a framework gets in the way.

3 year experience in RAG engineering Production experience with document processing and chunking strategy, embedding model selection, vector and hybrid (BM25 + dense) retrieval, reranking, query decomposition, GraphRAG and agentic RAG patterns, context-window budgeting, and grounding/citation enforcement. Able to diagnose whether a bad answer came from retrieval, ranking, or generation.

AWS AI stack – 3 years of experience –

Amazon Bedrock — Converse API, model selection and routing, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Flows, prompt caching, batch vs. real-time inference and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Observability, Code Interpreter, Browser

Amazon SageMaker AI for custom model hosting, training, and endpoint operations and Vector and search: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, S3 Vectors, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, Amazon Kendra.

5 years of experience in AWS core services Lambda, Step Functions, ECS/EKS/Fargate, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, VPC and PrivateLink. Able to design a VPC-isolated, private-endpoint deployment for a regulated client without help.

7+ years of experience in Python engineering Production-grade Python — async, typing, Pydantic, FastAPI, structured testing. Clean, reviewable code; not notebook-only.

2+ years of experience Evaluation and LLMOps Offline and online evaluation design, RAGAS or equivalent retrieval metrics, trace-based observability (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions, CloudWatch, Langfuse/LangSmith or similar), prompt and model versioning, token and cost governance, drift and regression detection.

2+ years of experience AI security and responsible AI Prompt injection and tool-abuse threat modeling, scoped tool permissions and action approval design, data classification and PII handling, content filtering, auditability. Working familiarity with an AI governance framework such as NIST AI RMF.

**Good to Have**

Model optimization — fine-tuning and LoRA/QLoRA, distillation into smaller or open-weight models, SLM deployment, structured decoding, latency/cost optimization under SLA.

Multimodal and voice — Amazon Nova models, Transcribe, Polly, real-time voice agent architectures and Infrastructure as code and CI/CD — AWS CDK or Terraform, GitHub Actions or CodePipeline, containerization, environment promotion strategy.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
**Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer**
------------------------------------

### **Position Summary**

As a Sr. Staff Data Platform Engineer, you will be the primary architect and visionary for the core data infrastructure that powers the entire enterprise. This is a "platform-as-a-product" role; your mission is to build the internal foundation—creating the high-performance engines, abstraction layers, and self-service frameworks that enable hundreds of other engineers to move faster.

You will operate at the intersection of Systems Programming and Data Engineering, solving "hard-tech" problems like automated schema evolution, multi-engine compute optimization, and global data discovery. As a top-level technical individual contributor, you will bridge the gap between long-term business strategy and deep-kernel technical execution, ensuring WEX’s data platform remains a competitive advantage.

Is this role for you?

* YES, if: You are a Backend/Software Engineer who loves solving "Big Data" problems, building APIs for data discovery, and optimizing distributed systems.
* NO, if: Your primary expertise is writing SQL queries, building Tableau dashboards, or managing ETL workflows without deep experience in Java or Python system architecture.

### **Responsibilities**

* Architectural Sovereignty: Define the 3-5 year technical roadmap for the Data Lakehouse. You aren't just using tools; you are deciding how storage, compute, and metadata layers (e.g., Apache Polaris, Unity Catalog or Datahub Catalog) interact at an elemental level.
* Platform-as-a-Product: Build internal SDKs, CLI tools, and automated orchestration frameworks. Your goal is to abstract away cloud complexity via Control Planes and Custom Operators, allowing Data Engineers to focus on business logic rather than infrastructure boilerplate.
* Internal R&D: Prototype and benchmark emerging technologies (e.g., specialized Spark extensions) to keep the platform at the bleeding edge of performance and cost-efficiency.
* Global Governance & Security: Architect "compliance-by-design" systems. Automate data lineage, PII masking, and fine-grained access control across petabyte-scale environments without sacrificing developer velocity.
* Engineering Excellence & Influence: Set the gold standard for code quality and system design across the company. You will lead Cross-Functional Architecture Reviews and serve as the final escalation point for the most complex system outages or performance bottlenecks.
* Organizational Mentorship: Beyond individual mentoring, you will foster an "Engineering Community," influencing the hiring bar and professional development paths for the entire data engineering organization.

### **Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 15+ years in software engineering and distributed systems, with at least 4 years in a principal or staff-level capacity leading platform-scale initiatives.

**Core Technical Competencies (Software Engineering Focus):**

* Strong Software Foundations: Strong fundamentals on software engineering, system architecture, and scalable production applications (Algorithms, Data Structures, and System Design).
* Experience in the Java/J2EE ecosystem (Spring Boot, Microservices) and python. We are looking for a developer who writes clean, testable, and high-performance code, not just scripts.
* Data as a Product: Experience building the platforms / framework engines and APIs that power data movement, rather than just building the ETL/ELT pipelines themselves.

**Data Lakehouse Mastery:**

* Deep internal knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Hudi, or Delta Lake (metadata management, manifest files, and compaction strategies).
* Experience contributing to or deeply customizing open-source data projects (e.g., Spark, dbt).

**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

* Extensive experience with cloud architecture and services, including AWS (S3, EMR, Kubernetes, Lambda) and Azure.
* Deep understanding of CI/CD automation, modern development tools, Git Actions, Terraform and frameworks.

**AI-Driven Development & Productivity:**

* AI Native Development: Experience leveraging AI Code Gen platforms into software development lifecycle (SDLC) to automate code generation, reviews, generate unit tests, and perform root-cause analysis of system failures.
* LLM-Ops for Platform: Ability to architect the infrastructure required to support AI Agent development by enabling vector database integration.

**Leadership & Vision:**

* Proven track record of "leading by influence"—driving adoption of new technologies across multiple autonomous teams.
* Ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs (e.g., "Latency vs. Consistency" or "Build vs. Buy") to C-suite executives and junior engineers alike.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science (Distributed Systems focus) preferred, or equivalent deep industry experience.

* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.

* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.

* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.

* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.

* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.

* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).

* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

title: Lead Firmware Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a senior firmware engineer who can independently own the reliability of embedded systems — from real-time sensor arbitration on shared buses to fleet-wide OTA delivery that never bricks a device. You've led firmware teams, driven low-level architecture decisions, and shipped connected hardware to production in a fast-paced, sensor-driven environment — pet wellness, wearables, or IoT.

**What You'll Do**

* Architect and build reliable, real-time firmware on an RTOS, tuned for determinism, power efficiency, and long-term field stability
* Lead sensor and bus arbitration across I2C, SPI, and UART — no data collisions, no timing failures under load
* Own BLE firmware design, balancing continuous high-frequency streams with bursty event-driven data, without loss
* Design and harden OTA pipelines — canary rollouts, rollback, boot-loop recovery — for a live device fleet
* Own firmware-level battery charging safety, clock tree stability, and thermal cutoff logic, working closely with the hardware team
* Take end-to-end ownership of one or more firmware modules, balancing reliability, maintainability, and time-to-market
* Set and enforce firmware testing standards, including hardware-in-the-loop and automated testing
* Mentor firmware engineers, review code, and raise the engineering bar across the team
* Work in an agile environment alongside hardware, ML, and app teams — sprint planning included

**You Might Be a Fit If…**

* You have a B.Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, or related field from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, or equivalent) — mandatory
* You have 10+ years of proven embedded firmware experience
* You have strong hands-on experience with RTOS-based firmware and protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, and BLE
* You've designed OTA update systems — safe rollout, rollback, and recovery from failure states
* You have a solid understanding of clock trees, power and battery management, and sensor arbitration under real-time constraints
* You're proficient in C and C++ for embedded and microcontroller-based systems
* You're familiar with Agile methodologies, with a track record of leading or mentoring engineers
* Bonus: experience with thermal sensors, IMUs, or camera modules on embedded platforms
* Bonus: shipped firmware for a consumer hardware product at fleet scale
* Bonus: familiarity with cloud platforms and device telemetry integration
* Bonus: prior experience in a startup or fast-scaling hardware environment

Pay: Up to ₹5,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
