title: SQA Manager
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence is seeking a Senior QA Engineer with 10–15 years of relevant experience to lead quality engineering for Gallagher Drive analytics products. The role will define and govern the QA strategy across Power BI reports and dashboards, data and ETL pipelines, APIs, and supporting applications. The Senior QA Engineer will provide hands-on technical leadership, establish repeatable QA processes and controls, guide automation architecture using Python, PyTest, and Playwright, drive risk-based release readiness, mentor QA resources, and partner with business, product, development, data, and reporting leaders. This is a senior technical individual-contributor role; direct people-management responsibility should be confirmed separately by the hiring manager.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

* **QA Strategy and Governance:** Define the end-to-end quality strategy, operating model, risk-based test approach, entry and exit criteria, evidence standards, release gates, sign-off controls, SOPs, checklists, and regression governance across analytics products.
* **Test Leadership and Assurance:** Lead planning and assurance for functional, integration, system, regression, data, API, ETL, reporting, smoke, performance, security-related, and release validation; ensure appropriate coverage across critical business journeys.
* **Power BI Quality Engineering:** Establish testing standards for data accuracy, DAX calculations, semantic models, filters, slicers, interactions, drill-through, navigation, refresh behavior, role-based access, visual standards, accessibility, and performance.
* **Data and ETL Quality Leadership:** Define source-to-target reconciliation controls and data-quality rules across source systems, ETL pipelines, Snowflake or equivalent warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting outputs.
* **Automation Strategy and Architecture:** Define scalable automation architecture using Python, PyTest, Playwright, API frameworks, reusable libraries, test-data utilities, reporting, and CI/CD integration. Prioritize automation based on risk, business value, repeatability, effort, and maintainability.
* **Visual Regression and Baseline Governance:** Establish Playwright or comparable browser automation for Power BI navigation, screenshot capture, visual comparison, threshold management, approved baseline updates, and defect triage for unexpected changes.
* **Azure DevOps Traceability and Controls:** Establish requirements-to-test-to-defect traceability, evidence standards, dashboards, workflow controls, defect templates, and execution reporting in Azure DevOps or an approved comparable tool.
* **Defect Governance and Root Cause Analysis:** Lead defect triage, severity and priority alignment, defect-ageing reviews, root-cause analysis, corrective-action tracking, fix verification, and learning from escaped defects.
* **Release Readiness and Executive Reporting:** Provide concise decision-oriented reporting on requirements and test coverage, execution progress, defect trends, open high-severity risks, automation coverage, dependencies, residual exposure, and release recommendations.
* **Cross-Functional Quality Leadership:** Partner with product owners, business analysts, engineering leaders, data engineers, Power BI developers, architects, scrum masters, security teams, and business stakeholders to make requirements testable and address quality risks early.
* **Capability Building and Knowledge Sustainability:** Mentor QA engineers, conduct reviews, define reusable templates and assets, maintain current operating procedures, facilitate knowledge transfer, improve backup readiness, and reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation:** Use quality metrics, defect patterns, delivery retrospectives, and value-stream analysis to identify process improvements. Evaluate AI-assisted testing, specification-driven approaches, and new tooling through governed proofs of concept.
* **Compliance, Security and Test Data:** Ensure QA practices follow approved privacy, masking, access-control, environment, open-source package, and secure test-data requirements.
* **Stakeholder and Delivery Management:** Manage competing QA priorities across products, communicate trade-offs and resource constraints, escalate blockers early, and align testing investment with customer and business outcomes.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of software quality assurance experience, including technical leadership for complex data, analytics, reporting, API, and application testing.
* Demonstrated experience defining QA strategy, governance, standards, entry and exit criteria, evidence expectations, release gates, and sign-off recommendations.
* Advanced SQL and data-validation capability covering reconciliation, profiling, joins, aggregations, transformation-rule validation, and investigation of data discrepancies.
* Strong Power BI quality-assurance experience covering DAX, semantic models, data, interactions, role-based access, refresh, performance, visual standards, and regression governance.
* Strong data and ETL testing experience with Snowflake, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, SSMS, ADF, or comparable cloud data platforms and pipeline technologies.
* Hands-on Python and PyTest experience, including reusable framework design, fixtures, utilities, assertions, reporting, and automation maintainability.
* Experience with Playwright or a comparable browser automation framework for UI and visual regression testing and baseline governance.
* Experience with API testing, CI/CD integration, source control, automated execution reporting, and controlled adoption of open-source packages.
* Advanced Azure DevOps experience for test management, requirements traceability, defect governance, dashboards, sprint visibility, and quality reporting.
* Experience leading defect triage, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, release-readiness reviews, and executive or leadership-level quality reporting.
* Ability to mentor QA engineers, influence without formal authority, lead cross-functional quality discussions, and create sustainable knowledge-transfer practices.
* Strong business acumen, strategic communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, analytical thinking, and evidence-based decision-making.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience establishing or scaling a QA Center of Excellence or shared quality-engineering capability.
* Experience with AI-assisted testing, specification-driven test generation, automated defect creation, or governed use of enterprise AI platforms.
* Performance testing experience using JMeter, k6, or comparable tools; accessibility testing knowledge is an advantage.
* Knowledge of data lineage, metadata, observability, data contracts, masking, access controls, and secure non-production environments.
* Experience measuring automation return, manual-effort reduction, defect leakage, coverage, cycle time, and release confidence.
* ISTQB Advanced/Test Manager, CSQE, Microsoft Power BI, Snowflake, Azure, Python, Agile/Scrum, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification or training.

**Education And Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, data, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
* 10–15 years of relevant QA experience. Talent Acquisition and Compensation should confirm the final career level, career band, and education wording before publication.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

* Databricks
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional

**What You Can Expect**

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 5 to 7 years of experience in Mainframe Host Network administration and support.
* Strong experience in z/OS Communications Server, including VTAM, TCP/IP, Enterprise Extender, and SNA administration.
* Expertise in DNS, IP routing, network security, packet analysis, connectivity diagnostics, and network performance tuning.
* Experience with problem determination, communications infrastructure support, and enterprise network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2016/2019, VMware ESX, and public/private cloud environments, including on-premises to cloud migrations.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills in production environments.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with IBM z/OS Communications Server, VTAM configuration, Enterprise Extender (HPR/IP), and SNA networking.
* Knowledge of TLS/SSL, encryption, firewall management, and secure network communications.
* Experience with Wireshark, OSA/Sniffer, NetView, OMEGAMON, and enterprise monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with OSA-Express, HiperSockets, Parallel Sysplex, and IBM Z networking technologies.
* Experience in network performance monitoring, capacity planning, disaster recovery, and high-availability architectures.
* Understanding of ITIL Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Experience with automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), vulnerability management, Active Directory, and ADFS.
Strong stakeholder management, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:

We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

**In this role you will:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure Salesforce solutions, services, integrations, and platform components that support Expedia Group products and business operations.

* Drive code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and solution assessments across Salesforce services and adjacent domains, identifying opportunities to simplify solutions, reduce technical debt, and improve performance, scalability, and quality.
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Salesforce features and services, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, release management, and continuous improvement.
Work across Salesforce, application, data, cloud, and platform domains as needed, demonstrating familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows; applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products; and safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years with a master’s degree.
* Proven experience owning complex software systems end to end, including system design, API design, data modeling, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce development, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce security concepts, and governor-limit-aware design.

* Proven experience owning Salesforce features, integrations, or services end-to-end, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, production support, and resolution of operational issues.
* Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce development and configuration capabilities, at least one modern programming or scripting language and its ecosystem, and experience with low-level system design, API and integration design, data modeling, service-oriented architectures, and secure coding practices.
Solid understanding of software engineering and Salesforce fundamentals, including platform architecture, data access and security, identity and access management, automation, distributed systems concepts, integration patterns, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Salesforce certification such as Platform Developer II, Platform Developer I, Salesforce Administrator, or an equivalent specialization.
* Experience with Salesforce Platform Events, Change Data Capture, asynchronous Apex, middleware, or event-driven integrations.
* Experience with observability, service-level indicators and objectives, incident management, root-cause analysis, and operational readiness reviews.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Experience influencing technical direction across teams and communicating architecture or operational recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Experience with data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or related data-platform concepts.

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

description:
**Company Description**

As Japan’s semiconductor powerhouse and a top global player in microcontrollers, analog, and power technologies, Renesas delivers real‑world impact across EVs, smart factories, renewable energy infrastructure, and edge intelligence. For ambitious problem‑solvers who want to work on meaningful, systems‑level challenges with huge industry leverage, Renesas offers the scale, stability, and strategic clarity of a market leader—paired with the transformative momentum of a company reinventing how the world computes, connects, and electrifies.

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

 **Job Description**  

* Be a part of end‑to‑end verification execution for SOC owning complex digital IP’s and subsystems from specification to sign‑off
* Define and drive IP‑level verification strategies, including test plans, coverage models, and closure criteria
* Develop scalable, reusable UVM‑based verification environments for IP and subsystem verification
* Lead functional, code, assertion, and cross‑coverage closure, ensuring high‑quality sign‑off with clear metrics
* Apply AI/ML‑assisted verification techniques to accelerate coverage convergence, identify stimulus gaps, and optimize regression efficiency
* Drive constraint random and directed test methodologies for thorough protocol, corner‑case, and stress verification
* Collaborate with RTL, Architecture, Emulation, and SoC Verification teams to ensure seamless IP integration
* Review IP specifications and work with architects to translate requirements into robust verification plans and checkers
* Develop and deploy advanced checkers, scoreboards, assertions (SVA), and protocol monitors
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and adopt next‑generation verification, coverage, and analytics tools
* Support Gate‑Level Simulation (GLS), low‑power verification, and post‑silicon debug when required.
* Ensure IP deliverables meet quality, schedule, and reusability expectations for SoC integration.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electronics Engineering
* 1 - 2 years of experience in SoC Verification domains and have working knowledge of industry standard EDA toolkits.
* Strong expertise in UVM‑based testbench architecture and development
* Proven experience in metric‑driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure
* Deep understanding of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions (SVA), and verification best practices
* Experience with directed and constrained‑random verification methodologies
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post‑silicon environments
* Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with working knowledge of C/C++, Shell scripting
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills

**Preferred/Plus Qualifications**

Hands‑on experience using AI/ML‑based verification tools for:

* Coverage gap analysis
* Test stimulus optimization
* Regression triage and coverage acceleration
* Scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or TCL for automation and analytics
* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal‑simulation flows
* Familiarity with high‑speed or complex IPs, such as:
* H.264
* Security, debug, or safety‑crititical

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

 **Job Description**  

* Be a part of end‑to‑end verification execution for SOC owning complex digital IP’s and subsystems from specification to sign‑off
* Define and drive IP‑level verification strategies, including test plans, coverage models, and closure criteria
* Develop scalable, reusable UVM‑based verification environments for IP and subsystem verification
* Lead functional, code, assertion, and cross‑coverage closure, ensuring high‑quality sign‑off with clear metrics
* Apply AI/ML‑assisted verification techniques to accelerate coverage convergence, identify stimulus gaps, and optimize regression efficiency
* Drive constraint random and directed test methodologies for thorough protocol, corner‑case, and stress verification
* Collaborate with RTL, Architecture, Emulation, and SoC Verification teams to ensure seamless IP integration
* Review IP specifications and work with architects to translate requirements into robust verification plans and checkers
* Develop and deploy advanced checkers, scoreboards, assertions (SVA), and protocol monitors
* Work with EDA vendors to evaluate and adopt next‑generation verification, coverage, and analytics tools
* Mentor junior engineers and promote best‑in‑class verification practices and continuous improvement
* Support Gate‑Level Simulation (GLS), low‑power verification, and post‑silicon debug when required.
* Ensure IP deliverables meet quality, schedule, and reusability expectations for SoC integration.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering.
* 2 - 4 years of experience in SoC Verification domains and working knowledge of industry-standard EDA toolkits.
* Strong expertise in UVM-based testbench architecture and development.
* Proven experience in metric-driven verification, including functional and code coverage closure.
* Deep understanding of SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions (SVA), and verification best practices.
* Experience with directed and constrained-random verification methodologies.
* Experience debugging complex design issues in simulation, emulation, and post-silicon environments.
* Proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with working knowledge of C/C++, and Shell scripting.
* Experience in verification of MCU-based SoCs and subsystems, including CPU cores, AHB/APB/AXI bus protocols, interrupt controllers, GPIO, timers, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, low-power features, and embedded peripherals.
* Strong understanding of MCU architectures such as ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, or equivalent embedded processor architectures.
* Knowledge of firmware-driven verification techniques and embedded software interaction with MCU peripherals is desirable.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred/Plus Qualifications:**

Hands-on experience using AI/ML-based verification tools for:

* Coverage gap analysis
* Test stimulus optimization
* Regression triage and coverage acceleration
* Scripting expertise in Python, Perl, or TCL for automation and analytics.
* Exposure to formal verification and hybrid formal-simulation flows.
* Familiarity with high-speed or complex IPs, such as:
* H.264
* Security, debug, or safety-critical IPs
* Experience with MCU functional safety concepts (ISO 26262), low-power verification, secure boot, and embedded system validation is a plus.
* Experience with firmware development/debugging in Embedded C or RTOS-based environments is desirable.

  
**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

title: Identity Architect
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Role Purpose**

The **Power BI and Azure Fabric Administrator** is responsible for the Design, Deployment, Administration, Stability, Optimization, Governance and Security & Compliance adherence of the Microsoft Power BI and Azure Fabric Platform being used as enterprise Data Analytics and Intelligence Platform of Haleon.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Microsoft Power BI, Azure Fabric (Microsoft Fabric), and modern data platform governance, combined with strong stakeholder management skills in a global enterprise environment. The Power BI and Azure Fabric Administrator manages and coaches a mid-sized, globally distributed operations team, while possessing deep expertise in Microsoft Power BI, Azure Fabric (Microsoft Fabric), and modern data platform governance, combined with strong stakeholder management skills in a global enterprise environment.

The role plays a critical part in meeting the organisation’s Power BI and Azure Fabric Strategy, Governance, Risk, Compliance, working closely with Architecture, Engineering, Data Governance, Sustainability Data Product teams and enterprise stakeholders.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Platform Administration and Operations**

* Administer and manage enterprise Power BI Service and Microsoft Fabric environments.

* Lead and Manage L2/ L3 Operations of Power BI and Microsoft Azure Fabric Platforms.

* Define and enforce governance frameworks including workspace strategy, naming conventions, access controls, and lifecycle management

* Implement tenant-level configurations, security policies, and compliance standards.

* Oversee Premium/Fabric capacity planning, workload management, and performance tuning.

* Ensure high availability, performance, and stability of enterprise Power BI and Azure Fabric Platform.

* Track & Ensure SLAs, SLOs and KPIs for Platform Operations.

* **Incident, problem, change, and release management** , applying ITIL best practices.

* Own Problem Management and Root Cause Analysis of Critical and Recurring incidents.

* Drive Operational Excellence and continuous improvement

* Maintain SOPs, Runbooks and Knowledge Repositories.

* Define and execute Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity strategies for the platform.

* Ensure compliance with **security, regulatory, and validation requirements** across all Data Platforms.

Plan, Lead and Execute OPEX cost optimization initiatives.  

  

**Technical Leadership & Hands** ‑ **On Contribution**

* Provide **technical leadership and direction** across the enterprise Power BI and Microsoft Fabric Platforms.

* Contribute directly in a **hands** ‑ **on capacity** to the administration, troubleshooting, and optimisation.

* Troubleshoot dataset refresh failures, gateway issues, and report performance bottlenecks.

* Optimize semantic models and large-scale datasets.

* Lead platform administration activities, including:

* Environment management and monitoring

* Patching and upgrades

* Disaster recovery and resilience planning

* Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate Azure Data Services (Data Factory,Synapse, Lakehouse, etc.) with Power BI/Fabric.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including infrastructure, security, and analytics for end-to-end platform delivery.

* Support end-to-end data pipelines and ensure seamless data availability for reporting.

Define standardized onboarding frameworks, checklists and Runbooks. Strong focus on Service Improvement Initiatives, Quality of Service, Compliance adherence, Security of data and IT resources.  

  

**Monitoring and Support**

* Ensure 24X7 Monitoring, Alerting and Response

* Set up monitoring frameworks using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Fabric Admin and 3rd party tools.

* Set up automated alerts and error-handling mechanisms to ensure platform uptime and proactive issue resolution.

Monitor system usage, capacity, and performance; optimize for scalability and cost efficiency.  



**DevOps & Deployment**

* Implement CI/CD pipelines for Power BI and Fabric using Azure DevOps or similar tools.

* Manage version control, automated deployments, and environment promotions (Dev/Test/Prod).

Promote best practices in code management and reusable assets.  



**People, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Power BI & Azure Fabric Platform, including permanent staff, contractors, and strategic partners.

* Ensure appropriate capability, capacity, and skills are in place to meet operational and delivery commitments.

* Manage agency resources and external vendors to ensure high-quality outcomes.

* Foster a performance‑driven, collaborative culture across globally distributed teams.

* Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate Azure Data Services (Data Factory, Synapse, Lakehouse, etc.) with Power BI/Fabric.

* Collaborate closely with **Data Product &** **Enterprise Architecture teams** including but not limited to Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Sustainability, Cloud Platform Engineering and related business owners.

* Partner with business stakeholders across marketing, sales, finance, and supply chain.

* Guide teams on best practices for dashboard design, data modeling, and performance optimization.

Conduct training sessions and enable self-service BI adoption.  



**Security, Risk & Governance Manag**

* Ensure risks and issues related to owned platforms, programmes, and projects are **identified, recorded, and actively managed** .

* Implement and maintain governance, security policies, and audit trail mechanisms across the Fabric environment.

* Conduct regular access audits, review workspace activity, and monitor compliance across environments.

* Ensure Timely Communication to stakeholders during outages, High Impact Incidents and Changes.

* Support governance processes through engagement with **Architecture Review Boards and Data Architects** across the data platform area.

Ensuring close alignment to internal & external regulatory and compliance requirements, Security, Quality, Governance & with no critical or high findings or violation against them.  

  

**Qualifications & Skills:**

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

Strong experience in deployment, implementation, operations and service delivery of **Azure Data Platforms**

Strong Hands-on expertise in:

* Power BI Services and Azure Fabric Platform Administration

* Proficient in SQL, DAX, and scripting (Python/Shell/PowerShell) for platform automation and analytics.

* Excellent knowledge of Power Bi and Fabric Administration best practices.

* In-depth understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data ingestion, and transformation within and outside Fabric

* Strong Experience in performance tuning, system monitoring, and troubleshooting in enterprise environments

* Ability to manage large-scale dataset refreshes, security roles, and workspace permissions

* Expertise in Documentations for maintaining Security, Data Lifecycle, Access Management & Publishing standards.

* Scripting experience for automation tasks (e.g., data extraction, cleanup, monitoring)

* Strong understanding of Data Security, Privacy, Governance and Compliance

* Strong Experience in Incident, Change and Problem Management with ITIL best practices.

* Disaster recovery and resilience

* Quality and compliance adherence

* Proven people leadership and team management capabilities.

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence across technical and non‑technical audiences.

* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with a pragmatic, delivery‑focused mindset.

* Ability to operate effectively in a **fast** ‑ **paced, highly regulated, matrix organisation** .

* Strong understanding of business objectives and operational priorities.

* Strong focus on Service Improvement Initiatives, Quality of Service, Compliance adherence, Security of data and IT resources.

* Fluent written and spoken English

**Experience Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent.

* **Minimum 10 years’ experience** in Power BI Service and Microsoft Fabric Administration, Technical Service Delivery.

* Strong Technical Experience in Power BI Services and Microsoft Fabri

* Good understanding of Azure Cloud and Data Platform technologies.

* Excellent understanding and proven track record of establishing ITIL and Agile principles in a large organization.

* Proven experience **managing teams** and leading enterprise‑scale Data Platform initiatives.

* Experience operating within regulated environments with strong understanding of Quality, Data Security and compliance expectations.

* Familiarity with **Haleon Quality System** principles, policies, procedures, and standards is preferred.

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-10-19  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:
Date: 10/13/26

Description:

**Company Description**

We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking AI Solutions Architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI solutions powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). This role demands hands on expertise in designing scalable AI architectures, integrating cutting-edge tools, and ensuring safety, observability, and performance at scale. This role also requires collaboration with engineering leads to drive AI innovation/ discussion, drive technical decisions, ensure delivery ownerships and include Gen AI capabilities in the existing product roadmaps/ frameworks.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in Software engineering, AI/ML systems, system/ solution engineering, distributed architecture, and platform design, along with recent hands-on work in Generative AI, multi-agent systems, LAG/RAG pipelines, and AI governance. You should be equally comfortable reviewing legacy software architectures, mentoring engineers, working with cross-functional stakeholders, and driving production readiness of AI systems.

Key Responsibilities :-

AI Platform Architecture: Design and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise AI systems spanning LLM orchestration, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM gateways, and API layers. Define reference architectures, design patterns (ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Tool-Use), and enforce architectural standards through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems: Architect and implement production multi-agent systems with specialized agents (content generation, compliance auditing, data retrieval, orchestration), inter-agent communication protocols, tool/function calling frameworks, plugin registries, and memory management (conversation buffers, working memory, long-term vector stores). Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints, fallback chains, and graceful degradation patterns.

Production RAG Systems: Design production-grade RAG pipelines including document ingestion (PDF, DOCX, HTML with tables, images, multi-column layouts), chunking strategies (recursive, semantic, document-structure-aware, parent-child), hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + metadata filtering), re-ranking, query analysis/rewriting, citation enforcement, and hallucination detection.

LLM Strategy & Model Routing: Define multi-provider LLM strategies across Claude (Anthropic), GPT-4o (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), and open-source models (Llama, Mistral). Architect intelligent model routing that optimizes for cost, latency, and capability. Evaluate and recommend models for specific use cases based on capability fit, context window, compliance, and deployment constraints.

LLMOps & AgentOps: Build CI/CD pipelines for AI systems prompt versioning and regression testing, automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, LLM-as-Judge), model A/B testing, and staged rollouts. Design observability infrastructure with full execution tracing, token tracking, cost attribution, latency SLAs, and quality dashboards using AgentOps, LangSmith, Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.

Evaluation & Quality Assurance: Design multi-layered evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics (RAGAS, BLEU, ROUGE), LLM-as-Judge pipelines with bias mitigation, embedding-based similarity, and domain-expert human review. Build and maintain golden test datasets (500+ curated QA pairs). Define monitoring for retrieval health, hallucination rates, empty retrieval rates, and user satisfaction.

Explainable AI (XAI): Implement explainability at multiple levels input attribution (RAG citations with chunk-level source mapping), reasoning traces (structured Chain-of-Thought with audit trails), confidence calibration, uncertainty quantification, and contrastive explanations. Produce model cards, data sheets, and system documentation for regulatory compliance.

Responsible AI & Governance: Establish and lead the Responsible AI program including guardrail architecture (input/processing/output guardrails with declarative configuration), bias detection and fairness evaluation pipelines, red-teaming exercises (prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial attacks), AI security measures, PII redaction, privacy-by-design, and regulatory compliance (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, FDA AI/ML guidance, GDPR/CCPA).

Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Business, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders to translate requirements into AI roadmaps. Mentor a team of 20+ engineers through design reviews, technical coaching, and career development. Drive build-vs-buy-vs-open-source decisions and present technical strategy to executive leadership.

Technical Skills :-

Languages & Frameworks: Expert Python; proficient JavaScript/TypeScript. FastAPI, Flask, or Django for backend APIs. ReactJS or Streamlit for AI interfaces.

LLM & Agent Frameworks: Microsoft Agent framework, AutoGen, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Strands Agents, Semantic Kernel. Deep knowledge of ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, and Tool-Use orchestration patterns.

Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) and/or Azure (Azure OpenAI, AI Studio, Cognitive Services). Multi-cloud experience preferred.

Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector, ChromaDB, or Milvus in production environments.

Document Processing: Azure Document Intelligence, PyMuPDF, Unstructured.io, LlamaParse. Experience with tables, images, and complex PDF/DOCX extraction.

Data & Storage: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch. Data modeling for AI-driven applications.

Observability & MLOps: AgentOps, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, Weights & Biases. CI/CD for AI (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

LLM Gateway: LiteLLM, Portkey, or custom gateway development for multi-model routing, rate limiting, and cost tracking

Key Competencies :-

Strong architectural thinking with the ability to balance scalability, simplicity, cost, speed, and risk.

Strong people leadership and mentoring capability.

Ability to drive delivery while maintaining technical quality.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability in ambiguous environments.

High ownership mindset with focus on business impact and production outcomes.

Commitment to responsible, secure, and ethical AI adoption.

Education :-

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.

Ph.D./ Publications or contributions to AI projects/ international journals is a plus

**Qualifications**

AI - Data Science BE/ Btech/ BCA/ Mtech / MBA )

**Additional Information**

This position is required to be filled urgently for Content Supply BU. Would request for quick action.

title: Senior HPC Cloud Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You will be the primary architecture reviewer and performance champion for new data center clusters being built across multiple sites globally.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the build-out and day-to-day operation of NVIDIA's VLSI high-performance compute environments in the public cloud, and the repeatable patterns that let us stand up the next environment faster than the last.
* Bring up and operate large compute clusters on Google Cloud end to end - instance provisioning, machine images, OS pipelines, networking, identity and quota management.
* Build the automation that makes cluster bring-up reproducible: infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, image build pipelines, and host lifecycle automation including hostname and identity preservation across maintenance events.
* Extend the same patterns to new on-premises data centers so cloud and on-prem run on one toolchain rather than two, and work with networking and storage teams on cross-site connectivity, latency budgets, and what is cross-mounted versus kept site-local.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will debug at depth when clusters misbehave - image and boot issues, mount failures, scheduler-host interactions, capacity and quota problems - and partner with the scheduling and operations engineers so what you build is operable by the whole team, not only by you.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering, with substantial time running production compute at scale.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with a major public cloud, Google Cloud preferred - compute, networking, IAM, storage, quotas, and the operational realities of running thousands of instances rather than tens.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code and configuration management skills (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent), plus experience with machine image build and OS lifecycle pipelines for large fleets.
* Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting: filesystems, NFS mounts and latency, networking, boot and image pipelines.
* Working understanding of data center and network fundamentals for compute-intensive workloads - topology, bandwidth and latency characterisation, and the practical limits of cross-site operation - along with familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and how compute nodes join, leave and are managed within them.
* Strong Python automation, experience bringing a new environment, cluster or data center online end to end, and the ability to work effectively across time zones. Semiconductor/EDA exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Architect II
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are ready to revolutionize your career and the world of technology with an iconic company. Now is the time to take the reins on this exciting opportunity.
  
  
As an Architect III at JPMorganChase within the Corporate and Investment Banking - Risk and Control Management team, you serve as a seasoned member of a team by incorporating leading best practices and collaborating with other architects to develop high-quality architecture solutions for various software applications and platforms. You are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

* Executes architecture solutions and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down problems
* Applies enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate architecture analysis and design (e.g., option evaluation, trade-offs, and documentation), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity and security requirements.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong knowledge of one or more software applications and architecture development within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* Working knowledge of applying enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to software engineering workflows (e.g., requirements interpretation, design support, code/test assistance) with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to evaluate and integrate AI-enabled features and architectural patterns (e.g., model/service integration, retrieval patterns, monitoring considerations) while maintaining security, resiliency, and auditability expectations.

* Proficient in coding in one or more languages

description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

DADAI (Data, Analytics, Digital & AI Delivery) is building a next generation enterprise delivery engine that turns the company’s biggest opportunities into measurable outcomes using data products, digital automation and applied AI. The ambition is to combine startup pace with enterprise discipline: product thinking, predictable delivery at scale, strong engineering standards, and clear architecture, security and quality gates that enable speed without compromising control. DADAI has been shaped as an enterprise “factory”, 200+ engineers, designed to absorb significant demand across multiple global domains, industrializing the path from idea to production and continuous improvement while scaling through strategic partners and still preserving internal knowledge and ownership. This is a rare opportunity to join a new leadership organization and to help set how the Teva will use data, analytics and AI to modernize decision making, automate critical processes, and accelerate innovation across core functions and value chains.

The AI Technical Lead owns the technical delivery of production-grade AI systems across enterprise digital, data, and analytics environments. This role sets engineering direction and provides strong hands-on leadership to design, build, deploy, and operate enterprise AI capabilities on a Microsoft-first stack, including agentic systems, generative AI applications, AI-enabled automation, and ML-powered platforms, ensuring consistent standards, quality, governance, security, and reliable global operations.Partners with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, legal, and central AI/data governance teams to enable delivery teams (internal and external partners) to build scalable, compliant, and auditable AI solutions across regions, cloud environments, and delivery models.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

* Accountable for all AI engineering activities with in the DADAI delivery factory.
* Lead the design, build, and operation of enterprise AI solutions on a Microsoft-first stack, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, and Azure services.
* Remain highly hands-on: review architecture and code, build proofs of concept, troubleshoot complex issues, and guide implementation teams through production hardening.
* Define and enforce engineering standards for AI delivery, including evaluation, monitoring, release controls, security, privacy, and Responsible AI practices in regulated environments.
* Work across architects, platform teams, security, and delivery stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are scalable, supportable, compliant, and aligned to business needs.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* 7+ years of proven experience leading and developing large (20+) engineering teams, including direct people management responsibilities, coaching, performance management, career development, and hiring in a complex enterprise environment.
* 10+ years in software engineering, including senior hands-on design and delivery of applications and API in a modern Microsoft cloud environment.
* 2+ delivering complex enterprise production GenAI and agentic solutions on Microsoft technologies such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, RAG, and evaluation workflows.
* Strong Azure engineering background, including Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Entra, CI/CD, monitoring, and production support.
* 10+ years Hands-on technical leadership with proven ability to build POCs, MVPs and production applications, review code and architecture, troubleshoot production issues, and lead implementation teams by example.
* 5+ years of experience working in enterprise or regulated environments with strong security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI controls.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across architecture, security, delivery, and business teams.
* BSc/BA in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience; relevant Azure or AI certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills**
--------------

* Hands-on builder and technical leader who can design, prototype, review, and unblock complex AI implementations.
* Strong problem-solving across prompts, models, retrieval, orchestration, runtime behavior, performance, and cost.
* Ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, delivery plans, and engineering trade-offs.
* Practical understanding of AI SDLC, evaluation, monitoring, rollback, and operational readiness for production systems.
* Clear communication and strong collaboration in cross-functional, global delivery environments.

**Core Technology Stack**
-------------------------

* **AI platforms**: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow
* **Azure engineering**: Azure Functions, App Services, AKS, API Management, Logic Apps, Event Grid, Service Bus
* **Engineering and SDLC:** Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, Azure Machine Learning, CI/CD, evaluation pipelines, observability
* **Security and governance**: Microsoft Entra, Purview, Key Vault, Defender, Azure Policy
* **Data and analytics**: Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Power BI, SQL

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------
