title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do
  
Analyze and Solve
  

* Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes
* Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities
* Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability
* Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions

  
Design and Integrate
  

* Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies
* Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation
* Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors
* Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity

  
Collaborate and Deliver
  

* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians
* Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines
* Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders
* Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results

  
Grow and Advance
  

* Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies
* Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects
* Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

  

* Strong hands-on experience in **Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI)** administration.
* Expertise in **Azure Stack HCI, Nutanix, VxRail, Hyper-V, VMware, and VMware ESXi** .
* Deep understanding of **Hyperconvergence Architecture** , Hypervisor administration, and cluster operations.
* Experience with **Nutanix Administration** and **Nutanix Architecture** .
* Knowledge of patch management tools such as **SCCM** , **WSUS** , and related enterprise patching solutions.
* Strong understanding of security vulnerability management and compliance requirements.
* Experience coordinating maintenance windows, change management, and outage communications.
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure, virtualization, and patch-related issues.
Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Data & AI Architect to define and govern the target architecture for Advanced Analytics, AI, and Data Products across SVD TEC. As the Data & AI Architect, you will ensure that analytics and AI initiatives are built on a scalable, secure, reusable, and governed foundation rather than isolated project-specific solutions.

You will define architecture standards, integration patterns, data contracts, AI deployment approaches, and governance models that enable teams to consistently deliver analytics and AI capabilities across products such as EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance. You will act as the technical authority connecting business needs, product strategy, data platforms, AI services, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and product teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Define and maintain the target Data & AI Architecture for SVD TEC.
* Establish standards for data ingestion, storage, processing, analytics, AI, and interoperability.
* Design reusable architecture building blocks and reference patterns.
* Define architecture principles for Data Products, Data Governance, Data Quality, Analytics Platforms, MLOps, AI Platforms, Agent Architectures, Knowledge Graphs, GraphRAG, and Integration Services.
* Drive architectural alignment across SDA, EMS, O4O, EcoMAIN, OBS AI, and future initiatives.
* Define integration approaches between internal platforms, customer environments, industrial systems, cloud services, and AI capabilities.
* Establish data contracts, API standards, interoperability guidelines, and reusable integration patterns.
* Participate in technology evaluations and partner assessments.
* Review and approve architectural decisions for major AI and analytics initiatives.
* Support cybersecurity, compliance, and governance reviews.
* Define transition strategies from PoC to MVP to production.
* Coach engineers and project teams on architecture best practices.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and architectural debt early.

**Mandatory Requirements:**

* Strong experience as Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect, Data Architect, Analytics Architect, or AI Architect.
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures and analytics platforms.
* Experience designing enterprise-scale data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of Data Lakehouse architectures, Data Warehousing, Data Mesh, Data Products, Data Governance, Metadata, Data Catalogs, Event-driven architectures, API architectures, and Cloud-native architectures.
* Experience with AI deployment architectures, MLOps, and operationalization of models.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience balancing long-term architecture goals with delivery realities.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills & Attributes:**

* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Foundry, Fabric, Cognite Data Fusion, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with industrial data platforms, time-series data, asset models, historian systems, and IoT architectures.
* Hands-on experience with Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Layers, GraphRAG, Agentic AI Architectures, Multi-Agent Systems, Vector Databases, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, identity management, confidential data handling, and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent systems thinking and ability to identify architectural dependencies across products and teams.
* Pragmatic mindset that prioritizes business value while maintaining architectural integrity.

**About the Team:**

Join the Advanced Analytics team responsible for establishing the long-term Data & AI foundation across SVD TEC. This role will shape how analytics, AI, digital products, and industrial data platforms evolve over the coming years. You will ensure that innovations in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, AI assistants, analytics products, and agentic AI are built on a common architecture that is scalable, maintainable, secure, and reusable across the portfolio.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

title: Platform Architect
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Platform Architect** to define and drive the architecture of a modern, cloud-native platform supporting scalable, secure, and resilient applications.

The role requires strong expertise in **containerization, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, Redis, multi-tenant architecture, and cross-region deployment**. Microsoft Azure experience is preferred.

The Platform Architect will work closely with engineering, DevOps/SRE, security, and product teams to establish platform standards, reference architectures, and reusable technical patterns.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the overall architecture and technical direction for the platform.
* Design scalable and resilient **microservices-based architectures**.
* Establish standards for containerized workloads and Kubernetes deployments.
* Define cloud architecture using Azure services and cloud-native design principles.
* Design secure and scalable **multi-tenant architectures**, including tenant isolation and resource segregation.
* Define **multi-region deployment**, failover, disaster recovery, and resilience strategies.
* Design caching and distributed state-management solutions using **Redis**.
* Establish standards for service communication, API design, asynchronous messaging, retries, resiliency, and fault handling.
* Define platform security patterns including identity, access control, secrets management, and workload isolation.
* Define observability standards for logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and service health.
* Guide Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, and automated platform deployment practices.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and drive resolution of architectural risks and technical debt.
* Create and maintain reference architectures, design documentation, and architecture decisions.
* Mentor engineering teams on cloud-native and distributed-system design practices.

**Core Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

**Containerization**

* Strong experience with Docker/OCI containers.
* Understanding of container lifecycle, security, networking, and image optimization.

**Kubernetes**

* Strong hands-on architectural knowledge of Kubernetes.
* Experience with:
* Deployments, StatefulSets, Services, and Ingress
* ConfigMaps and Secrets
* Autoscaling and resource management
* Persistent storage
* RBAC and network policies
* Cluster and workload high availability
* Experience with **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)** preferred.

**Microservices & Distributed Systems**

* Strong understanding of:
* REST APIs and service-to-service communication
* Event-driven and asynchronous architectures
* API gateways
* Service decomposition
* Resiliency patterns
* Distributed transactions
* Eventual consistency
* Idempotency
* Fault tolerance and graceful degradation

**Cloud Architecture**

* Strong cloud architecture experience, preferably with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Familiarity with relevant Azure services such as:
* AKS
* Azure Container Registry
* Azure Front Door / Application Gateway
* Virtual Networks and Private Link
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Managed Identities
* Key Vault
* Azure Monitor / Application Insights
* Azure Storage
* Azure SQL or equivalent databases
* Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs
* Azure Managed Redis

**Redis**

* Experience designing Redis for:
* Distributed caching
* Session or transient state
* High availability
* Replication and clustering
* Cache invalidation
* Performance optimization

**Multi-Tenant Architecture**

* Experience designing SaaS or shared platforms with:
* Tenant isolation
* Identity and authorization boundaries
* Data and resource segregation
* Tenant provisioning
* Noisy-neighbor mitigation
* Tenant-level monitoring and configuration

**Multi-Region Architecture**

* Experience designing:
* Regional deployment patterns
* Active-active and active-passive architectures
* Traffic routing
* Disaster recovery
* Regional failover
* Data replication
* RTO/RPO strategies

**Preferred Skills**

Experience in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Bicep
* Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
* Helm and GitOps
* Kafka, Azure Service Bus, or Event Hubs
* OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana
* API Management and service mesh
* SQL and NoSQL databases
* Zero-trust and cloud security
* SRE and reliability engineering practices

**Experience**

* Typically **10+ years of software or platform engineering experience**.
* At least **4–6 years of experience in cloud-native and distributed-system architecture**.
* Proven experience architecting production platforms using Kubernetes and microservices.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient systems.

**Key Architecture Competencies**

The candidate should be able to evaluate architectural trade-offs such as:

* Shared vs dedicated tenant infrastructure
* Shared Kubernetes clusters vs tenant-specific clusters
* Database-per-tenant vs shared database models
* Stateless vs stateful services
* Synchronous APIs vs asynchronous messaging
* Active-active vs active-passive regional deployments
* Managed cloud services vs self-managed components
* Security and isolation vs infrastructure cost

title: Sr. Security Specialist
description:
### **About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business. Could you be the one to make a difference?

### 

### **About the role**

As a **Senior Associate – Security Architecture, Design & Proof of Value**, you will drive impactful contributions and focus on outcomes. You will be part of the Cybersecurity Architecture & Risk organization, supporting the architecture, design, assessment, and validation of security technology solutions.

You will combine security architecture consulting with hands-on participation in Proof of Concept (POC) and Proof of Value (POV) activities. Working with Senior Managers, security architects, enterprise architects, engineering teams, and technology vendors, you will translate security requirements into practical designs, validate security controls, assess emerging technologies, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

### 

### **In this role, you will:**

* Support security architecture and solution-design reviews across cloud, applications, infrastructure, data, identity, network, and AI domains. Translate business and technology requirements into security requirements, architecture patterns, control recommendations, and practical solution designs.
* Participate in architecture assurance, threat modelling, and design reviews to identify security gaps, dependencies, risks, potential attack paths, and recommended remediation. Assess controls covering IAM, privileged access, workload/service identities, segmentation, encryption, secrets, logging, monitoring, and data protection.
* Plan and execute cybersecurity POCs/POVs by defining use cases, scope, success criteria, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, required integrations, data flows, identities, connectivity, and security controls.
* Perform hands-on configuration, integration, and testing of security technologies in approved POC/POV environments. Validate vendor capabilities against requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, collect objective evidence, and document gaps, limitations, dependencies, risks, and recommendations.
* Develop architecture and data-flow diagrams, security-control mappings, test cases, technical assessments, reusable security architecture patterns, assessment checklists, and POC/POV documentation. Contribute to final reports and leadership presentations and provide status updates on technical issues, dependencies, actions, and risks.

Embrace Cognizant’s culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Prioritize quality, stay curious, commit to continuous learning, take ownership, and build relationships.

### 

### **What you must have to be considered**

* **6–9 years of experience in information/cybersecurity**, with practical exposure to security architecture, solution design, security engineering, or consulting.
* Hands-on experience participating in and delivering cybersecurity POCs/POVs, technology evaluations, or pilots.
* Good understanding of enterprise security architecture principles and secure-by-design practices.
* Practical knowledge across multiple security domains such as IAM, cloud security, network security, application/API security, data security, or security operations.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Ability to understand architecture diagrams, data flows, APIs, and technology integration patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with attention to technical detail.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to clearly explain technical security concepts.
* A strong sense of ownership and commitment to creating meaningful outcomes, consistent with the corporate template’s required attributes.

### 

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience supporting cloud and hybrid security assessments.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, privileged access, and workload/service identity security.
* Understanding of network security, segmentation, and Zero Trust principles.
* Knowledge of application/API security, data security, encryption, DLP, security monitoring, and logging.
* Experience with third-party technology and security assessments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI security assessments, including identity, data protection, model/API security, agent/tool security, and governance controls.
* Experience with threat modelling, security-control validation, architecture assurance, and design reviews.
* Ability to develop clear technical assessments and evidence-based recommendations for senior stakeholders.

### 

### **Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a **hybrid position open to qualified applicants anywhere in India**.

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on the project as well as business and client requirements.

title: Products & Solutions Development Team Leader
description:
**Job Requirements**  

**Engineering Manager – Digital Backbone**

**Role purpose:** Build the teams, engineering system, and leadership capability that turn Digital Backbone into the reusable, trusted foundation for Siemens Healthineers’ next generations of connected, cloud-ready, AI-enabled healthcare products. The role combines people leadership, product-minded engineering management, and cross-organization influence to convert platform strategy into measurable customer, business, and engineering outcomes.

**What Digital Backbone Is**

Digital Backbone is the common digital and engineering foundation that connects products, services, data, devices, and clinical workflows across Digital & Automation. It provides reusable platform capabilities for cloud, edge, and on-premises deployments so business lines can innovate faster without repeatedly rebuilding infrastructure, integration, deployment, data, fleet, licensing, observability, and workflow capabilities. Its value is not measured only by platform delivery, but by the speed, quality, reuse, interoperability, and new business outcomes it enables across the Siemens Healthineers ecosystem.

**What Digital Backbone Must Enable in the Coming Years**

* **One engineering foundation across deployment models:** enable containerized components and consistent development, integration, release, and operation across cloud, edge, and on-premises environments.
* **Reusable platform products at enterprise scale:** shift from local solutions to governed capabilities that multiple business lines can discover, adopt, integrate, and evolve.
* **Connected and interoperable healthcare ecosystems:** strengthen common services for clinical information exchange, workflow orchestration, fleet and device connectivity, deployment, data, analytics, licensing, and business operations.
* **AI-ready and AI-native healthcare engineering:** provide safe, auditable foundations for AI-enabled workflows while embedding responsible AI into the software lifecycle, engineering knowledge, quality, and productivity.
* **Faster customer value and new business models:** shorten time-to-market, decouple software development from delivery, expand fleet-wide services, and enable subscription, metering, marketplace, and data-driven offerings.
* **Operational trust at scale:** make reliability, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory evidence, observability, supportability, and lifecycle sustainability intrinsic platform qualities.
* **A product-oriented global operating model:** create clear end-to-end ownership, transparent priorities, strong domain leadership, and accountable collaboration across product, engineering, architecture, quality, and business stakeholders.

**Engineering Manager Mission**

Create an environment in which autonomous, inclusive, high-performing teams deliver dependable platform products and continuously increase their impact across Digital & Automation. The Engineering Manager owns the health and capability of the engineering organization: the right people, skills, ways of working, quality discipline, delivery system, and partnerships needed to scale Digital Backbone outcomes.

**Core Accountabilities**

* **Translate strategy into team outcomes:** connect Siemens Healthineers, Digital & Automation, BTT, platform, and product priorities to clear team objectives, roadmaps, technical investments, and measurable outcomes.
* **Own organizational capability:** build balanced teams, identify future skill needs, develop succession, grow technical and people leaders, and enable mobility across products, domains, and geographies.
* **Lead predictable value delivery:** establish outcome-based planning, dependency and risk management, transparent flow metrics, and effective collaboration across teams without reducing agility to ceremony compliance.
* **Drive engineering excellence:** improve architecture realization, software craftsmanship, automation, CI/CD, test strategy, cybersecurity, reliability, observability, maintainability, and lifecycle cost.
* **Scale platform adoption and reuse:** treat internal consumers as customers, reduce onboarding friction, actively manage feedback, avoid duplicate solutions, and make reusable capabilities the preferred path.
* **Lead responsible AI transformation:** model effective AI use, establish human validation and governance, develop AI-native skills, and convert successful experiments into reusable engineering practices and product value.
* **Manage end-to-end ownership:** ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape cross-functional decisions:** partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value.
* **Build a trusted culture:** create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement.
* **Represent engineering:** communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes.

**Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships**

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans.

**Measures of Success**

* **Accountability:** the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency.
* **Customer and ecosystem impact:** adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners.
* **Delivery performance:** predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues.
* **Engineering quality:** automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost.
* **AI and modernization impact:** measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches.
* **People and capability:** critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development.
* **Business contribution:** avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered—not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. The role offers influence across business lines and geographies, combines people leadership with technology transformation, and turns engineering excellence into visible customer and business impact.

* **Manage end-to-end ownership:** ensure teams understand and own build, release, operation, support, quality, and improvement of their platform products throughout the lifecycle.
* **Shape cross-functional decisions:** partner with Product Managers, Architects, System Engineers, Quality, Cybersecurity, Operations, and business lines to resolve trade-offs and align investment with enterprise value.
* **Build a trusted culture:** create psychological safety, high standards, inclusion, accountability, candid feedback, and space for experimentation and learning. Promote and protect Peakon participation and leverage it as strategic tool for employee engagement.
* **Represent engineering:** communicate progress, risks, options, and impact in business language; influence priorities and secure the decisions, funding, and staffing needed for sustainable outcomes.

**Role Boundaries and Key Partnerships**

The Engineering Manager is accountable for people, engineering capability, delivery health, and the environment in which technical decisions are executed. Product Managers own product value, priorities, and market outcomes; Architects own architectural direction and integrity; technical leaders guide implementation and engineering practices. The Engineering Manager connects these accountabilities, makes ownership explicit, removes systemic barriers, and ensures decisions become dependable outcomes rather than parallel plans.

**Measures of Success**

* **Accountability:** the degree to which the engineering manager can create accountability amongst developers and team leadership acting as the anchor for stability and transparency.
* **Customer and ecosystem impact:** adoption, active consumers, integration lead time, reuse, customer outcomes, and satisfaction of internal and external partners.
* **Delivery performance:** predictable commitments, shorter lead time, improved flow, controlled dependencies, and faster recovery from issues.
* **Engineering quality:** automation, defect escape rate, reliability, security posture, observability, maintainability, and reduced technical debt or lifecycle cost.
* **AI and modernization impact:** measured productivity and quality gains, reusable AI-enabled workflows, responsible adoption, and migration from legacy approaches.
* **People and capability:** critical-skill coverage, internal growth, leadership pipeline, engagement, inclusion, retention, and evidence-based development.
* **Business contribution:** avoided duplication, lower cost to serve, faster time-to-market, platform-enabled revenue opportunities, and progress against strategic targets.

**What Makes This Role Exciting**

This is an opportunity to shape how future healthcare software is built and delivered—not only to manage an existing team. The Engineering Manager will help create the foundation on which connected devices, interoperable clinical workflows, AI-enabled solutions, fleet services, and future software-defined products can scale. The role offers influence across business lines and geographies, combines people leadership with technology transformation, and turns engineering excellence into visible customer and business impact.

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: SOC - Detection Engineer
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Your Role**
-------------


* Design, develop, and continuously improve detection use cases, analytics rules, correlation logic, anomaly detection models, threat hunting queries, dashboards, and watchlists across Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and related security platforms.
* Translate threat intelligence, incident findings, red/purple team outcomes, emerging threats, and business risks into prioritized detection requirements aligned with organizational security objectives and MITRE ATT\&CK coverage.
* Create, test, validate, tune, and maintain detection logic using KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection\-as\-code methodologies while minimizing false positives and improving detection effectiveness.
* Collaborate with SOC, Data Onboarding, and Security Automation teams to ensure telemetry readiness, SOAR integration, operational validation, documentation, and successful production deployment of detections.
* Conduct threat hunting, attack emulation, behavioral analytics, and continuous detection coverage assessments while maintaining detection lifecycle governance, quality metrics, release management, and ongoing enhancements.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Security Analytics with demonstrated ownership of the end\-to\-end detection lifecycle, content validation, and cross\-domain threat detection capabilities.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Data Explorer (ADX), KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection engineering best practices, including analytics development, tuning, testing, and operationalization of security content.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), Detection\-as\-Code, testing automation, content repositories, platform integrations, peer review processes, and detection release management within SOC environments.
* Experience working with Azure Data Explorer, Databricks, Jupyter/iPython Notebooks, MSTICPy, security data science, statistical/ML analytics, and data engineering concepts to develop and operationalize advanced hunting, anomaly detection, and behavioral analytics use cases.
* Proven experience with attack emulation and detection validation frameworks such as Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Prelude, AttackIQ, Sigma, YARA/YARA\-L, as well as fraud, identity, cloud, SaaS, OT, data leakage, and network anomaly detection use cases.
**What you will love working in Capgemini**
-------------------------------------------


* Design, develop, and continuously enhance detection use cases, analytics rules, correlation logic, anomaly detection models, threat hunting queries, dashboards, and watchlists using Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, and related security platforms.
* Create, validate, tune, and maintain detection logic using KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection\-as\-code methodologies while reducing false positives and improving overall detection effectiveness.
* Clear career progression paths from engineering roles to architecture and consulting.
* Be part of mission\-critical projects that ensure security, compliance, and operational efficiency for Fortune 500 clients.

title: Senior Architect (Data, Cloud, AI)
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

Ellucian is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next\-generation Data Platform and analytics solution. This role will be instrumental in transforming our current data warehouse ecosystem into a modern, scalable, cloud\-native Lakehouse platform capable of supporting analytics, AI/ML workloads, agentic AI experiences, and real\-time data products.


This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in data platforms, data warehouse, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and emerging AI technologies.


As a key technical leader , role offers opportunities to spearhead technical initiatives, mentor engineers at all levels, and work closely with internal product managers, experienced engineers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver advanced features that enhance student success and drive higher education transformation.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Build and own the target\-state architecture for a next\-generation Lakehouse platform.
* Develop technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and product vision.
* Lead architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, observability, security, and AI enablement.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures.

**Platform Modernization**

* Lead migration from traditional data warehouse architectures to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Design scalable data platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Evaluate and drive adoption of technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, DuckDB, Trino, Flink, Kafka, and cloud\-native analytics services.
* Design multi\-tenant SaaS architectures with strong security and data isolation.

**AI \& Intelligent Data Platform**

* Define architecture patterns enabling AI\-powered data experiences.
* Design platforms supporting:
* + Generative AI applications
	+ Agentic AI workflows
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector databases and semantic search
	+ AI\-assisted analytics and insights
* Partner with AI teams to operationalize ML and GenAI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine applicability to the platform roadmap.

**Technical Leadership**

* Take ownership of critical tasks from specification review through final testing and deployment, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as the highest level technical authority for the platform.
* Mentor architects and senior engineers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and guide critical design decisions.
* Drive engineering excellence and technical innovation across teams.

**Scalability, Reliability \& Operations**

* Architect for high availability, performance, resiliency, and cost optimization.
* Define observability and operational excellence standards.
* Drive platform reliability through automation and SRE practices.
* Establish governance around performance, security, compliance, and data quality.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: Bachelor / Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or related field. Overall 15\+ years of software engineering exp with 7\+ years of professional software development experience in a product or SaaS environment building modern Data platform.
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures including Data warehouse, Data Mesh, Data platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed data processing frameworks, Apache Spark, Trino, Flink, Kafka.
* Experience with open table formats, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.

  

* Strong understanding of Metadata management, Lineage, observability.
* **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing, building, and evolving large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and highly available production services.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering**: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, containerization, infrastructure automation, and modern operational practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* **Engineering Excellence**: Deep experience with CI/CD, code review, test automation, observability, release engineering, and DevOps practices in modern software delivery environments.
* **Security and Risk Awareness**: Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure design, and practical application security principles in enterprise software.
* **LLM and Agentic Systems Experience**: Demonstrated experience building or guiding solutions that use large language models, including agent\-based workflows, prompt and context design, tool orchestration, structured outputs, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation patterns.
* **Model Selection and Evaluation**: Experience working with multiple LLMs or AI providers and making practical tradeoff decisions across model quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and enterprise suitability.
* **AI Engineering Practices**: Understanding of core patterns for production AI systems such as retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, observability, prompt management, guardrails, fallback strategies, and secure handling of sensitive data.
* **Judgment and Governance**: Ability to evaluate AI\-generated output critically, define validation standards, identify risk areas, and maintain human accountability for technical decisions and delivered outcomes.
* **Technical Communication**: Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders around technical direction and execution tradeoffs.
* **Mentorship and Influence**: Proven experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, raising engineering standards, and shaping development practices across a team or organization.

title: Technical Lead - SFMC
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  

**Why This Role Matters:**  

Eli Lilly and Company is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Lead to drive the strategic development, implementation, and optimization of our Marketing Cloud platforms. This role will be instrumental in leveraging cutting\-edge marketing technologies to enhance customer engagement and support our global marketing initiatives, ensuring robust and scalable solutions.
  
  

**What You Will Do:**  

Technical Leadership \& Team Guidance
  
  

* Guide a team of Marketing Cloud developers and specialists through implementation challenges, setting technical direction, reviewing designs, and ensuring solutions are architecturally sound and aligned with best practices.
* Provide deep subject matter expertise in SFMC architecture, platform capabilities, and emerging features, ensuring the team applies the right approach at every stage of delivery.
* Conduct design and code reviews that elevate team output, to ensure work is done to the highest standard.
* Oversee end\-to\-end technical delivery of Marketing Cloud implementations, holding the team accountable to data integrity, system performance, compliance, and quality.
* Evaluate new SFMC features and releases, translating their potential into actionable recommendations for the team and stakeholders.
* Define and enforce development standards, governance policies, and security protocols.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, including active adoption of AI tools to help the team work smarter and deliver faster.
* Ensure the team maintains comprehensive technical documentation including architecture diagrams, design specifications, and operational procedures.


Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and actionable development plans aligned with IT strategy and marketing objectives.
* Collaborate with marketing stakeholders to prioritize initiatives, develop requirements, and ensure solutions meet business objectives.
* Lead technical design sessions and conduct design walkthroughs with both business and technical audiences.
* Lead grooming workshops, provide level\-of\-effort estimates, and maintain clear communication of technical scope and timelines.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, surfacing risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs before they become blockers.
* Participate in vendor management and evaluation for related marketing technology solutions.


**Your Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development and architecture experience.
* Experience in a Technical Lead or Senior Developer capacity with evidence of technical influence and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Hands\-on experience in AMPscript, SSJS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL within the Marketing Cloud environment and Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Hands\-on experience designing and supporting Marketing Cloud Connect implementations, including API integrations and data extensions that power cross\-channel campaigns.
* Experience applying data modeling, data architecture, and database concepts in a marketing context, including designing or maintaining marketing data structures for segmentation, targeting, or campaign execution.
* Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification(s), such as Email Specialist, Consultant, Administrator, Developer, or Architect.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies, including user story creation and sprint grooming.


Mindset \& Ways of Working
  
  

* AI enthusiasm and hands\-on fluency — you actively use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or similar LLMs to automate work, accelerate delivery, and solve problems faster. You don't wait for AI to become standard practice — you're already there.
* Strong learning agility — you stay ahead of a fast\-moving platform and proactively bring new knowledge into the team.
* Proactive problem\-solving — you identify issues early, involve the right stakeholders, and drive resolution without waiting to be asked.
* Strong self\-management — you operate independently, balance multiple priorities and shifting requirements, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.


Communication \& Influence
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills — you can translate complex technical concepts clearly for non\-technical stakeholders at any level of the organization.
* Ability to mentor and elevate others technically without formal management authority — you lead through expertise, trust, and example.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.

* Own:
* Hiring, onboarding, and retention
* Performance management and career development
* Succession planning and team structure


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Own **end\-to\-end delivery** of engineering initiatives across multiple teams.
* Translate product and architecture inputs into **execution plans with clear milestones**.
* Manage:
* Sprint execution, backlog prioritization, and release planning
* Risks, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination
* Ensure **predictable, high\-quality releases** using defined engineering metrics:
* Lead time
* Change failure rate
* Ensure predictable and well\-governed framework releases, including:
* Release notes
* Migration guides
* Backward compatibility considerations


**Technical Execution \& Platform Delivery**


* Drive delivery and implementation of **core platform** using Java, AWS, backend development tools.
* Ensure alignment with **architecture standards defined by the Architect**.

* Defining clear usage guidelines, patterns, and documentation
* Monitoring and improving core platform
* Partner with the **Architect** to implement architectural standards and ensure alignment with the broader strategy.
* Establish scalable processes for:
* Documentation and developer onboarding
* Feedback loops to continuously improve the platform
* Manage **dependencies and rollout strategies** across multiple teams.
* Define support and development, including issue triage, resolution timelines, and escalation paths for consuming teams.


**Platform Adoption \& Engineering Metrics**


* Define and track success metrics for platform, including:
* Developer onboarding time and productivity
* Defect trends and issue resolution timelines
* Use insights from usage and feedback to drive **continuous improvement of the platform**.


**Engineering Excellence \& Quality**


* Own enforcement of engineering quality standards and drive consistency across all teams.
* Ensure adherence to **engineering standards, coding guidelines, and best practices** defined at the org level.
* Drive implementation of:
* Automated testing (unit, integration, regression)
* CI/CD pipelines and release automation
* Track and improve **code quality, defect rates, and technical debt** within teams.
* Ensure **code quality (SonarQube), open\-source governance (FOSSA), and CI/CD quality gates**


**Performance, Reliability \& Observability**


* Ensure delivery meets **performance benchmarks.**
* Drive adoption of:
* Monitoring and observability (logs, alerts)
* Incident management and root cause analysis.
* Ensure systems meet **availability, scalability, and reliability expectations**.


**DevOps \& Release Management**


* Establish strong **release governance and operational cadence.**
* Progressive delivery (canary, blue\-green deployments)


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with:
* **Architect** for technical direction
* **Product teams** for roadmap alignment
* **Platform/Cloud teams** for scalability and reliability
* Communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs to stakeholders.

* Proven experience delivering **large\-scale product**.
* Strong expertise in:
* Java, AWS
* Back\-end architecture and scalable systems
* Experience working with **design systems and component\-driven development**.

September 16, 2026 \- October 1, 2026

You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget. As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation. At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre\-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.  

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  

  

Required Technical and Professional Experience
  

  

* Solid understanding of Data Center mainly Systems, Storage, Networking \& Security, Application \& Databases
* Understanding of Systems and Solutions Architecture
* Hands\-on experience \& learning with Data Center technologies, Cloud Software, and interoperability

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience
  

  

* MS Project or other Project Management software
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Sr. CSM, HCLS, AWSI India, AWS Industries, India CSM team
description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) services industry through the translation of a customer vision into actions that realize long\-term value through innovation? Do you have the business and technical acumen to earn trust with business executives and project team members alike? Are you a savvy problem solver motivated to surprise and delight customers and advocate on their behalf? If yes, then we would love to talk to you.



Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to come join our Global HCLS Services team to work with one or more of our largest HCLS services industry customers. CSMs help customers realize sustained business value by accelerating their cloud transformation journey.



Global HCLS Services CSMs are trusted advisors, applying experience and industry thought leadership to help customers realize the transformative value of inventing and building in the cloud.



Customer Influence – CSMs build the relationships needed in order to understand the customer, their business context, and their strategic goals in order to proactively guide and mitigate risks in their cloud journey.



Focus on Excellence – We take pride in leveraging the knowledge and expertise of our team in support of customer delivery, and celebrate the enhanced impact we have by bringing the best of AWS and partners in solutioning for customers.



Overcome Complexity through Agility – CSMs bring clarity to complexity. We evangelize experience\-based learning and an iterative approach to demonstrate results and value early. By prioritizing enablement and operational excellence, we strengthen our customers’ confidence in their ability to migrate and operate at scale on AWS.



Have Impact and Grow – We take intentional actions to support each other and recognize the impact this has. We bring our authentic selves, celebrate diverse perspectives, and ensure opportunities for growth and leadership are available to all.



Guided by Facts and Data – We rely on fact\-based results and data, contextualized through our expertise to inform functional priorities, and influence AWS services and industry solution opportunities.



Key job responsibilities From emerging startups to the largest global HCLS services companies, Customer Solutions Managers (CSMs) are Trusted Advisors guiding customers through the value realization, enablement, and governance facets of their cloud transformation journey.



Value Realization: You identify and accelerate the customer’s realization of value throughout the cloud adoption lifecycle through the introduction of AWS services, AWS partner solutions, AWS best practices, and other.



Enablement: You build and drive programs to achieve organizational cloud readiness and cloud fluency through skills guilds, experience\-based accelerators, training partners and other.



Governance: You establish and mature operating models / structures to drive scale and long\-term success through the application of cloud adoption framework, cloud center of excellence, communities of practice, and other.



A day in the life Empowered by an inclusive environment, work/life harmony, and career advancement, you are a member of a diverse, global community of Customer Solutions Managers (CSM) who deliver cloud solutions that influence business/IT transformation for our customers. Day\-to\-day, you will balance your time between directly engaging with customers, partners, and internal AWS teams to orchestrate execution of target customer outcomes.



You will act as the critical connective tissue between various AWS teams, apply your technical and program management expertise to solve some of the most complex and challenging technology problems today.



Working backwards from the customer:


* You will define opportunities and understand associated business and technical risks that are strategic to the customer’s cloud journey including large\-scale migrations, data and analytics, digital innovation, high performance computing, product innovation, business agility, and other.
* You will influence technical stakeholders at customer, pre and post sales and drive detailed business and technical discussions and alignment to deliver cloud adoption and migration strategies with, and on behalf of your customer.
* You create, manage, and deliver business and technology initiative programs navigating risks, roadblocks, and constraints applying acceleration frameworks effectively.
* You will serve as the customer’s cloud journey coach and be the voice of the customer within AWS, evangelizing customer needs to AWS leadership, product, and engineering teams
* To support the evolution of the AWS customer experience and/or Customer Solutions Manager discipline, you might also package best practice learnings into a reusable asset for internal re\-use.


Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.



About the team The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 5\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 2\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit \[https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations) for more information.
